name: Dammekärr Dirt Dash

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Övriga betalar 199 kr för tre deltävlingar.

description: Dammekärr Dirt Dash is a trail-running series in Dammekärr organised by the orienteering club OK Alehof. The competition consists of three races with combined scoring, and participants can choose to run one, two or all three races. The courses run through hilly forest terrain and come in three different distances: 1.5 km, 3.5 km and 7.0 km. The short course follows the floodlit trail, while the longer courses require a headlamp. After the finish, runners can enjoy a hot sauna and refreshments in the club cabin, creating a pleasant and social atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hilly forest terrain around Dammekärr
Short course (1.5 km) on the floodlit trail
Longer courses (3.5 km and 7.0 km) require a headlamp
additional: The competition takes place in the evening. Participation is free for OK Alehof members. Timing is done using a SportIdent card, which can be borrowed on site. After the race, a hot sauna and refreshments are available in the club cabin. The series features results, live updates and an archive of previous races.

name: Landehof 4-Årstider Höstloppet 2026
description: Landehof 4 Seasons Autumn Race 2026 is an orienteering event held at Landehofstugan, Landvetter, on November 3. The race offers a challenging autumn setting with darkness, rain, wind and slippery roots, providing an authentic autumn experience in the forest. Participants can enjoy an exciting, traditional orienteering experience in beautiful surroundings. Start lists and live results will be published well in advance of and during race day.
course_highlights: Orienteering in an autumn setting with darkness and slippery roots
Challenging terrain in the forest around Landehofstugan
Traditional autumn race with a long history and a strong sense of community
additional: The start list will be published from Friday, October 30, and updated until the registration deadline. Live results and the results list will be available. Register by logging in with your personal identity number on OK Landehof's registration page. QR codes are available to easily share the invitation and registration details with colleagues or training partners. Start and gathering point at Landehofstugan in Landvetter. A headlamp is recommended. Registration is open until November 1, 2026.

name: Energiruset
organizer: IF Göta Karlstad och Karlstads Energi
description: Energiruset is an evening race in Mariebergsskogen, organised in collaboration between IF Göta and Karlstads Energi. The race takes place on Thursday, 5 November 2026, and is family-friendly, with a choice of distances of 2 km and 5 km. The 5 km distance has a competitive category for those who want to test themselves; much of the course runs through woodland, and some sections are unlit. After finishing, all participants are treated to a hot dog by the organisers.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mariebergsskogen, including woodland.
Some sections of the course are unlit; a headlamp is recommended.
Distances: 2 km and 5 km; the 5 km has a competitive category.
additional: Date and location: Mariebergsskogen, Thursday, 5 November 2026. You can buy a headlamp when registering. Practical information (chip collection and exact start times) will be published on the organiser’s website. A previous race briefing is available as a PDF: https://ifgota.se/files/PM_ER_2025.pdf. After the race, IF Göta and Karlstads Energi will treat participants to a hot dog. The course will be open during the evening for non-competitive participants, who can start within a specified time window. The start times are tentatively around 18:00.

name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and other races take place on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and can also be used as qualifying races for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The event centre and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 the Swedish Veterans Championships in the half marathon will be held alongside the race. Runners of all abilities are welcome—the event emphasizes running community and clearly marked laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for 10 km, 1 lap for 5 km
Fast, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (measured 25 Sep 2021), and course marshals are stationed along the route
additional: The start, finish and event centre are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start locations vary by distance. The half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children’s race (500 m) at 12:45. Runners must keep to the right and pass on the left; runners who are not running at a fast pace are asked to keep right. In the relay, teams hand over a baton in the exchange area near the lap point; late registration is not available for Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration for other distances is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Payment is accepted in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten 10:30, 10 km 10:40, 5 km 10:45, 5 km youth class (ages 12–16) 10:45, children’s race 12:45. Start locations vary by distance. There is no late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course is a loop with water stations every 5 km, in cooperation with Umara. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from approximately 09:00. Free open training sessions are held on 17 September and 15 October before race day.

name: Skanneloppet
price_range: Fram till 7 oktober: 17,3 km 200 kr; 7,6 km 150 kr; 3,9 km 100 kr. 8 oktober – 24 oktober: 17,3 km 300 kr; 7,6 km 200 kr; 3,9 km 150 kr. 25 oktober – 5 november: 17,3 km 400 kr; 7,6 km 300 kr; 3,9 km 250 kr.
description: Skanneloppet is organised by IS Skanne and takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, starting and finishing at Tingvalla Nöjespalats in Åstorp. The race is run individually, with approximately ten runners starting per minute, and offers three courses for both elite runners and recreational participants. The courses are hilly and run mostly on gravel roads, with sections of asphalt and off-road trails. The race is suitable for both young and old. Information about registration and start lists will be published on the organiser’s website.
course_highlights: Three distances: Red 17.3 km, Blue 7.6 km and Green 3.9 km
Hilly terrain—mostly gravel roads, with sections of asphalt and off-road trails; particularly hilly at the beginning
Water stations are marked on the map (yellow circles)
additional: Bib collection from 08:00 on race day; find your bib number in the start list inside Tingvalla and collect it yourself. No on-site registration. Registration closes on 5 November. Those who register before 24 October will have their name printed on their bib. Start times are between 10:00 and approximately 11:05, with around ten runners starting per minute. The courses are hilly; the 17.3 km and 7.6 km courses include sections of off-road trails, asphalt roads and gravel roads, while the 3.9 km course is entirely on gravel roads and off-road trails. No showers or changing facilities; toilets are available. A commemorative plaque is awarded to everyone who finishes; commemorative medals are awarded after 5, 10, 20, 30 and 40 completed races. Contact: skanneloppet@isskanne.se, Diana Nilsson 070-847 73 47, Torbjörn Persson 0702-90 23 40.

images.alt_text: IS Skanne-logotyp från inbjudan till Skanneloppet.
Löpare vid start och mål för Skanneloppet i Åstorp.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Kroppefjäll Trailrun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900 meter: 0 kr för de allra minsta

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 350 kr för ungdom under 18 år

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 550 kr för ungdom under 18 år

description: Kroppefjäll Trailrun is an evening race at Kroppefjäll B&B in Dals Rostock, offering runners three main distance options (42 km, 21 km and 10.5 km) in two-person teams, as well as a children’s race around the pond. The course is technical terrain with plenty of singletrack and natural trails, and the race has a relaxed, adventurous atmosphere with no official timing. After the finish, participants can use the large sauna and take a refreshing dip in the pond. Accommodation can also be booked at Kroppefjäll B&B with discounts. The organisers welcome both experienced trail runners and younger participants (Lilla KTR) in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: Approx. 60% singletrack/off-trail, 35% gravel road/forest road and 5% oil-gravel road
Race format: trail running in two-person teams
Lilla KTR: children’s race around the pond (approx. 900 m), with the option to run 1–3 laps
additional: Bus to the start from Kroppefjäll B&B; GPX file for 21 km; bring your own fluids; bib pickup in the days before the race or the evening before; accommodation discounts via Trailrun1/Trailrun2; the Lilla KTR race takes place on 7 November at 18:00; registration deadline: 4/11.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Järnleden and offers three distances (15, 30 and 50 km). The race takes place on varied and characterful terrain—deep forests, bogs, small lakes, pastures and old trails—putting both mental toughness and the joy of running to the test. The start and finish are at Hultets friluftsgård, and the 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden. The organiser, Topp & Dröm, welcomes both experienced trail runners and those who want to try trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Järnleden through varied terrain (forests, bogs, lakes, pastures and old trails)
Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård; from 1 October, places are limited to ensure a specially designed medal for every participant; organiser: Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / telephone 073-853 75 21), and the information pages have sections on aid stations and equipment. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No cups are provided at the aid stations; bring your own cup. Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn. Entry fees are updated over time, and from 1 October, places are limited to secure a specially designed medal for every participant.

name: Finalloppet
description: Finalloppet is western Sweden’s largest cross-country race, organised by Göteborgs Skidklubb since 1968. The race offers several distances, from 1.9 km up to 19 km, on scenic and challenging terrain at Skatås Motionscentrum in Gothenburg. The courses are clearly marked with orange arrows and kilometre markers in different colours for each distance. The event is open to all ages and abilities, with start groups based on running times to create a good race experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings at Skatås Motionscentrum
Orange arrows and clear kilometre markers on all courses
Advanced trail section on the 19 km course with approximately 2500 metres
additional: Registration is via RaceID, with payment made at the time of registration. Start groups are based on running times to create evenly matched fields. There are water stations at several points along the courses. The Parvel course (approx. 250 m) can only be entered on site on race day for 40 kr. A sweeper follows runners on all courses for their safety. Insurance is included during the race and for travel to and from the event. Photography will take place, and photos may be used for marketing. The event arena is at Skatås Motionscentrum. The courses are marked with orange arrows and all have a sweeper. A medal is awarded at the finish. Paraloppet is 1.9 km, and there is also a Parvel course.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: Welcome to the 57th Jätten Bule Run on 31 October 2026 at Bulevallen in Österbymo. The race offers an enchanting forest setting, with trails and gravel roads winding through the area. There are recreational race classes for 10 km, 5 km and 2.4 km, where everyone can enjoy a challenging run surrounded by beautiful scenery. IFK Österbymo warmly welcomes all runners to a well-organised event with timing and excellent service.
course_highlights: The 10 km course runs along floodlit trails, forest paths and gravel roads across hilly terrain
The final 4 km take you through an enchanting forest on winding trails with both climbs and descents
The 5 km course is a miniature version of the 10 km course, marked in blue, while the 2.4 km course follows the floodlit trail
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 at the IFK Österbymo clubhouse by the start area. Timing is chip-based. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse. Refreshments, including coffee and hamburgers, are available at the start area. Payment by Swish or cash. Bulis will lead a warm-up at approximately 10:00 before the children’s race starts. Start and finish at Bulevallen, Idrottsvägen, Österbymo.

name: Mustaschmilen Göteborg
description:
Mustaschmilen takes place at Åbytravet in Gothenburg, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a festival on 7 November. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages, and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable stadium experience.

Mustaschmilen in Gothenburg has three distances: 5 km, 10 km and a 1 km children’s race. The two longer races will be run on a loop course, with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-metre course.
additional:
10:00 – Bib pickup opens
Be sure to pick up your bib well before the start.
11:00 – 5 km start, all paces
12:15 – Children’s race start, 1 km
12:45 – 10 km race start
14:00 – 10 km recreational start

About 10 minutes before each start, Runacademy will lead a group warm-up.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

name: Pop up Run Svartedalen
location: Bottenstugan parking, Svartedalen Nature Reserve, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, lättare lunch, dryck och kaka ingår.

description: Discover the magic of running in Svartedalen on a lovely 12 km trail through wilderness-like landscapes. The run takes you along winding forest paths, past mirror-still lakes and over hilly terrain that offers both a challenge and the joy of running. There are several stops along the way to enjoy the views and the special atmosphere of one of western Sweden’s most beloved natural areas. The run ends with a light lunch, a drink and cake at the shelter, creating a wonderful sense of community and an energizing morning for everyone taking part.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths through deep spruce forests
Mirror-still lakes and moss-covered sections
Hilly terrain with mountain-like landscapes
additional: The run is divided into 2–3 pace groups. Meet at the Bottenstugan parking area. After the run, a light lunch, a drink and cake are served at the shelter. Meet at 10:00 at the Bottenstugan parking area. 2–3 pace groups. A light lunch, a drink and cake are included.

name: FalkTrailen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 250kr för herr- och damklasserna.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barnloppet kostar 20kr som skänks till välgörenhet

description: Falktrailen is a trail race held at Falkenberg Motor Speedway in Falkenberg. The race offers lovely narrow trails and varied terrain suited to both experienced runners and recreational runners. There are several categories for women and men, as well as youth categories and children’s races. The course is mainly on trails, where trail shoes are recommended, but regular running shoes also work well. After the race, refreshments are available for purchase, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Most of the course runs along lovely narrow trails
Trail running on varied terrain
The race is held at Falkenberg Motor Speedway
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:00, with no timing, and all children receive a prize. Registration for the children’s race closes at 9:45. Refreshments are available during the event. SEK 20 per participant is donated to the Swedish Church’s fundraiser for families with children experiencing financial hardship in Falkenberg. The 2026 race is listed as starting at 10:30 from Falkenberg Motor Speedway. The date November 14, 2026 comes from the race information; another source gives November 15.

name: Mörkertrail
location: Garphyttans nationalpark entrance parking area, Lekeberg Municipality, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr för vuxna; 50 kr för deltagare under 18 år
description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run along a reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails, with the light from their headlamps as the only source of illumination. The race offers an atmospheric and challenging experience, with elevation gain and the quiet of the forest as companions. After finishing, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire. The start and finish are at the car park by the national park entrance, and the race starts at 17:00 on 14 November 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km trail in total darkness, with a headlamp as the only source of light
Reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails
Course with elevation gain on the edge of Kilsbergen
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:00. A short briefing takes place 10 minutes before the start. No on-site registration. The national park car park has limited spaces, so please carpool. Outdoor toilets are available, but there are no changing facilities. You must bring your own headlamp with a fully charged battery. The course has muddy sections and a water station halfway. Race bibs can be collected from 16:00; sausage and a drink are included after the finish. Places are limited, and there is no on-site registration.

description:
Mustaschmilen takes place at Jägersro Trotting & Galop, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a community celebration on November 14. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable stadium experience.

Mustaschmilen in Malmö has three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an encouraging commentator along the 1,000-metre course.

12:45 – 10 km start, race category

Runacademy will lead a group warm-up approximately 10 minutes before each start.

Together with the spectators, sponsors, and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable arena experience.

Mustaschmilen in Stockholm has three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-meter course.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and is promoted as an autumn highlight for trail runners. The race offers several distances, making it accessible to both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Preliminary race information and courses are published on the website, along with information about course previews ahead of the event. Organizer pages and the registration link are collected on the race website.
course_highlights: Running in Bockeboda Forest — woodland terrain near Kristianstad
Several distances: approx. 25 km (25–26.4 km), 12 km (12–12.9 km) and 5 km (5.3–5.7 km), depending on the measurement method
Course distances are listed with variations depending on different measurement methods
additional: Registration: the page mentions individual and group registration. The website mentions insurance and includes a registration link for a previous year’s edition (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). Course previews have also been held ahead of the race, and late registration has previously been announced as available via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad, and information about this year’s edition is available in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF’s website and the RaceID page.

name: RAMBO MOSSE NIGHT TRAIL

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgiften är 450 kronor till och med 30 oktober

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Är du klubbmedlem är loppet gratis

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Annars kostar det 50 kronor att delta

description: Rambo Mosse Night Trail is a unique trail race through the fascinating natural surroundings of Rambo Mosse Nature Reserve in Mölndal. The race, which is just over 11 km long, takes place at dusk, with headlamps and a course marked with reflectors, offering a special and challenging running experience on forest trails. The start and finish are at Herkulesgården, where participants can enjoy a sauna, showers and warming soup in the clubhouse after the race. The race is limited to 400 participants and includes a medal and awards for the top finishers in the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Just over 11 km on forest trails marked with reflectors
A gently undulating course featuring a mix of forest, bogs and rocky outcrops
Run by headlamp, starting and finishing at Herkulesgården
additional: Maximum 400 participants. All participants receive a training hat from Ullmax (value: SEK 149). Aid stations with water and Umara sports drink at approximately 4 km and 8 km, and after the finish. Electronic timing with a split time. After the race, showers, a sauna and warming soup with bread and a drink are available in the clubhouse. Race bibs can be collected the day before or on race day. Recommended equipment includes a headlamp with sufficient battery life and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is limited; public transport is recommended. Start and finish at Herkulesgården. Registration is via RaceID from 1 September and remains open until 25 November or until all 400 places are filled. The entry fee includes refreshments, soup after the finish, a training hat, a medal for all finishers, and access to changing rooms, showers and a sauna.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: Adventsjoggen
description:
Experience a magical start to the festive season with Adventsjoggen at Stora Hjortstorps Gård in Örebro on 29 November! Bring your friends, family or colleagues for a day filled with exercise, community and delicious food. Choose between a scenic 7.2 km or a challenging 15 km. There’s also a 600 m Kidsrun for the youngest participants.

After the race, a warming reward awaits: hearty goulash and freshly baked bread, all included in the entry fee! The course takes you through beautiful surroundings, starting and finishing at the farm, along idyllic landscapes past Rävgången and Naturens Hus.

name: Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg
location: Parking near Kungens kök, Halleberg, Vänersborg Municipality, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg 12-15 km

description: Celebrate the second Sunday of Advent with a unique running experience on Halleberg, one of western Sweden’s most spectacular table mountains. The route offers varied scenery and a close-to-nature experience through enchanting forests, past lakes and along beautiful trails, with changing terrain ranging from soft forest paths to technical sections and more open plateau trails. Along the way, enjoy magnificent views of Lake Vänern and fascinating geology that tells a story dating back hundreds of millions of years. After the run, participants gather for a festive Advent fika—a cosy and well-deserved end to the second Sunday of Advent.
course_highlights: Magnificent views of Lake Vänern
Running through enchanting forests and past lakes
Varied terrain with soft forest paths and technical sections
additional: The run is divided into 2–3 pace groups. Festive Advent fika is served after the run. Meet at the parking lot near Kungens kök. Start at 10:00. Meet at the parking lot near Kungens kök. Advent fika is included.

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night is a unique trail running race taking place in Dalby on December 12. The race features a 1 km light trail course with a substantial hill at the beginning. Participants run as many laps as they can within time limits that gradually decrease. It is a challenge combining speed and running strategy in dark, cold conditions, with the possibility of running up to 20 km. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, and prizes are awarded to many participants. The race is open to all levels and ambitions, and is organised with a focus on enjoying the forest.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail course with 24 m of elevation gain per lap
A substantial hill at the beginning of the course
Running in the dark and cold weather
additional: Participants have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, with broth possibly also available. Prizes are awarded to many participants. The number of places is limited. Start at the Dalbybadet car park at 15:30. Lap times decrease gradually: 10 minutes for the first lap, then 9 minutes and 40 seconds, followed by 9 minutes and 20 seconds. Water, cola and light refreshments are available at the lap point. Places are limited; bring a headlamp.

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet in Olofström is a traditional end-of-year race organised by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), run over two laps on the current course since 2018. There is also a shorter course of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured the finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen, providing a welcoming setting for runners and spectators. Its history and ties to the club make the race a festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon: 10,549 m (run over two laps on the current course since 2018)
A shorter course of approximately 5.3 km is also available
Finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord (as stated in the invitation). The race information and course maps are available as PDF files on the organiser’s pages (invitation, race information, course). The start list is published separately on the organiser’s website. Historically, the event has had changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen. Historical information and course profile, including the start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: Nyårsmilen Halmstad
description: Nyårsmilen in Halmstad is a festive New Year’s race where you can choose between 5 or 10 km on a fast, easy-to-run course along cycle paths in Halmstad. The start and finish are at the athletics track at Halmstad Arena, and the race uses chip timing via the race bib. After the finish, participants are treated to a medal, sparkling drinks, snacks, music and a great atmosphere, whether they run fast or take it easy. The race is open to everyone and is a perfect start to the new running year.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run course along cycle paths
The 10 km race consists of two laps
Start and finish at the athletics track at Halmstad Arena
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 to 10:10 at Halmstad Arena. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are displayed immediately after the finish. Toilets and changing facilities are available at the venue. Valuables can be left in the covered grandstand (unattended). Parking is about 200 metres from the start. Water and Umara sports drink are available after 5 km for 10 km runners. All runners receive a medal; if you decline the medal, SEK 15 is donated to the organisation Aldrig Ensam. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest women and men in each category. Pacing for the 10 km is available on request by email. The race takes place on 31 December 2026, with the start and finish at Halmstad Arena. Provisional start times are 10:30 for 10 km and 10:35 for 5 km. Race bibs can be collected at the arena between 9:00 and 10:10. Chip timing; toilets, changing facilities and parking are available at the arena.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: The Sylvesterloppet in Gothenburg is a spectator-friendly 10 km race held on New Year's Eve, starting and finishing at Heden. The flat course covers two loops through central Gothenburg, including Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and the area around Svenska Mässan. The race is suitable for all runners who want to end the year with a fast and festive running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and has a chance to win prizes in a draw.
course_highlights: Flat, two-loop 10 km course through central Gothenburg
Passes Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and Svenska Mässan
Spectator-friendly, festive atmosphere, with firefighters cheering runners on at Gårda fire station
additional: Start groups are assigned according to expected finish time: elite, start group 1 and start group 2. The warm-up begins 15 minutes before the start. Race bibs can be collected on 29–30 December and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30 at Exercishuset at Heden. Electronic chip timing using the chip on the race bib is used, and net times are shown in the results. The race starts at 12:00 on 31 December. Registration via MittLopp is available until one hour before the start, unless the race is full.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail is one of western Sweden’s most exciting and challenging winter trail races, offering distances of 30k, 60k, 90k and 180k. The races feature varied terrain, from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running in a magical setting. Whether you’re an ultrarunner or a recreational runner, there’s a challenge to suit you. Welcome to experience the community, challenge and joy of Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terrain ranging from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running
Elevation gain from approx. 1,000 m (30k) up to approx. 5,000 m (180k)
Magical winter scenery in the Gothenburg area
additional: The 180k race is an out-and-back race starting in Skatås and turning around at Tjolöholm. The Friday start time can be chosen freely between 11:00 and 20:00, but all 90k and 180k runners must start together at 06:00 on Saturday morning. Drop bags and a place to rest are available in Tjolöholm. Self-support applies on the Skatås–Tjolöholm section, according to Fastest Known Time rules. A headlamp is recommended for dark sections. There are time limits and several aid stations with closing times along the courses. The event is known for its scenic course and challenging terrain, making it a popular choice for trail runners in the region.

name: Becksvart
description: Becksvart is a unique night race held in total darkness, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides. Choose between two challenging and varied courses of 6 km or 12 km, taking you over logs and rocks, along narrow trails and across rocky outcrops around Gunnebo Castle, Kallebäck and Lackarebäcksfjället. The races are a perfect Friday activity focused on adventure and experience, with an AfterRun featuring food, drinks and music waiting in the finish area. There is also a secret contest within the race for anyone looking for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the dark, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides
The course follows unique trails around Norra Långevattnet, Lackarebäcksfjället and Kallebäck
Gothenburg’s most legendary hill—Hobo Hill, with 80 metres of elevation gain over approximately 200 metres (12 km course)
additional: Start and finish at Gunnebo Castle & Gardens. The courses are marked with reflectors attached to clothespins and trail markers. Bibs and timing chips can be collected at Nordic Wellness Krokslätt the day before and on race day. Unsupervised bag drop is available. There is one water station halfway around the course, and refreshments are provided after the finish. Medical staff will be on site. Bus 754 goes to Gunnebo Park. Parking is available below the castle, but not at the start/finish. AfterRun with food, drinks and music takes place in the finish area. Trail shoes with a substantial sole are recommended; a headlamp is mandatory. A headlamp is strongly recommended and described as mandatory on the race information page; trail shoes are recommended. There is a water station approximately halfway around the course. AfterRun with music, food and drinks awaits after the finish.

name: Götas ungdomsspel
location: Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, Karlstad, Sweden
price_range: 110–120 kr per gren; efteranmälan i mån av plats mot dubbel avgift
description: Götas Youth Indoor Games is an athletics competition for young people, held at the modern Eva Lisa Holtz Arena in Karlstad. The event provides a welcoming and supportive environment for young athletes to compete and develop in various athletics disciplines. The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.
course_highlights: The competition is held indoors at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, a modern venue with seating for 1,700 spectators
Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training
Organised by IF Göta Karlstad, a club with a long tradition and a strong record in athletics
additional: The competition takes place at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, which opened in 2022 and is a modern indoor venue for athletics and physical training. The multifunctional arena is also used for meetings and training courses. IF Göta Karlstad covers the entry fees for a maximum of three events per competition for its members. Entries for children and young people under 14 should be sent to the relevant group email address, or to tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se if no group email address is available. Enter by 24 January via EasyRecord or gus@ifgota.se. Participants compete in their age category or the senior category.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://ifgota.se/arrangemang/gotas-ungdomsspel-inomhus/inbjudan/): 2027-01-30 — "30 – 31 januari 2027, Karlstad" (was estimated 2026-09-04)

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race takes place in beautiful Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Stora Skuggan. Choose from three distances on snowy trails and enjoy a unique winter medal at the finish. After the race, warm up at the after-run with a hot drink and refreshments alongside other runners.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Norra Djurgården
Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, easily accessible by metro and bus
additional: Everyone who finishes receives a unique winter medal. Aid stations are located at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan, close to the metro and bus. After the race, a warming after-run with a hot drink and refreshments is available. Registration is through the partner EQ Timing and is binding, with no refunds. Refund protection can be purchased as an add-on through Startklar. Start and finish at Stora Skuggan. Registration is open until 29 January 2027.

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdomar har ett pris hela perioden fram till evenemanget.

description: Winter Run Stockholm is an atmospheric winter race taking place at Skansen and Djurgården on January 31, 2027. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a course that combines historic surroundings with beautiful winter scenery, illuminated by fire performers, torches and flares. The race also includes a children’s race for ages 7–11, making it an experience for the whole family. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% paved surface and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km through Skansen’s historic surroundings, with the rest around Djurgården
The course is illuminated by flares, fire baskets and a fire show
additional: Children’s race: 1.3 km for ages 7–11. Minimum age: 13 for 5 km (11 when accompanied by a parent or guardian) and 15 for 10 km (13 when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Skansen is a dog-free zone. The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. There is a risk of ice on the course, so shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Skansen opens to runners at 14:30. Start times: children’s race 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. There is also a children’s race for ages 7–11. Any surplus goes back to sport.

name: BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race offering runners a unique opportunity to experience the Åkulla beech forests in their winter dress. With distances of 5, 12 and 24 km, the race features magical trails and a wonderful atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and finish are at Öströö Fårfarm, and the event is characterised by community, commitment and respect for nature. Only 600 exclusive starting places are available, making this an intimate and special experience for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Winter trail in the Åkulla beech forests
Start and finish at Öströö Fårfarm
A magical winter landscape experience
additional: A total of 600 starting places are available: 5 km (150 places), 12 km (300 places) and 24 km (150 places). You must help other runners if needed. The start list is available online. Startklar and Startklar Plus insurance are offered for refunds in case of illness or injury. Traffic rules apply at road crossings. Littering will result in disqualification. For urgent assistance, call 076-8159678 or 112. The race starts at 10:00 from Öströö Fårfarm. There is one refreshment station with energy supplies along the course. The final registration date is 2 February 2027.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa is a winter edition of Mossarun, a trail race featuring a challenging, technical 21 km loop with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The race is self-supported and unstaffed, so participants navigate using a GPX file, with no trail markings. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event to warm up cold runners, and participants can grill their own food. Skis are allowed if there is enough snow, making it possible to combine running and skiing on the loop.
course_highlights: 21 km loop with 600+ metres of elevation gain
Technical, hilly terrain with high-quality trails
Unstaffed race with self-navigation using a GPX file
additional: The race is unsupported, with no timing or checkpoints. There is no cut-off time. Mandatory equipment includes an emergency blanket and a headlamp. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event for participants to warm themselves between laps. Participants can choose to run one or more laps. Skis are allowed when there is snow. Participants are encouraged to Swish any amount they wish to War Child or another organisation of their choice. An external race calendar lists the distance as 241.4 km; this information is not confirmed on Mossarun’s results page.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race held at Öströö Sheep Farm, featuring magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 12 km and 24 km, with the 24 km distance consisting of two laps of the 12 km course. With a total limit of 600 starting places, the organizers aim to give runners a unique experience of the beauty and challenge of the winter landscape. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads in a scenic setting. Safety and respect for nature are key principles of the event.
course_highlights: Magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests amid winter scenery
Varied terrain with trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads
The 24 km distance consists of two laps of the 12 km course, making it spectator-friendly and safe
additional: Start and finish at Öströö Sheep Farm. Maximum of 600 starting places in total. Start times: 12 km at 10:00 (300 places), 5 km at 10:15 (150 places), 24 km at 10:30 (150 places). The option to purchase Startklar insurance for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. The lap course allows runners to change equipment and is spectator-friendly. The event is environmentally friendly, with a focus on not littering. In case of an accident, call 076-8159678 or 112 in an emergency. The lap section allows runners to change equipment and makes the course more spectator-friendly.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: SFT - Skåne Frozen Trail
description: Skåne Frozen Trail is a trail running event offering several distances in the beautiful Snogeholm area, with the start and finish at Gydarps gård. The race features challenging and scenic routes on the Skåneleden and other trails, with distances of 12 km, 30 km and 50 km ultra. The event is open to all levels and focuses on competing against yourself rather than others, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Participants can enjoy well-marked courses, electronic timing, aid stations and warming soup after the finish. SFT is also part of the RUNTGS 70K Challenge 2027.
course_highlights: 30 km route on the Skåneleden and trails in Snogeholm
50 km ultra with 30 km + 20 km laps
New 12 km distance with 150 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: emergency blanket and mobile phone. Well-marked course with electronic timing. Manned aid stations at km 15/45 and an additional one near the finish area for the 50 km. Heated cabin with toilet and shower. Soup with bread after the finish. Limited number of places. Accommodation can be booked near the start/finish through Des ti nation Snogeholm. Start and finish at Gydarps gård in Snogeholm. Elevation gain: 150 m D+ for 12 km, 505 m D+ for 30 km and 830 m D+ for 50 km. Emergency blanket and mobile phone are mandatory equipment. Limited number of places.

name: Lapland Arctic Ultra
description: Lapland Arctic Ultra is an extreme winter race held in Överkalix, Swedish Lapland. The race offers several distances from 20 km to 500 km, and participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. The courses follow snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests, with spectacular views and challenging Arctic conditions. The start and finish are at Grand Arctic Resort, and the race crosses the Arctic Circle twice on the 185 km distance. This is a unique challenge for endurance athletes who want to test their limits in Europe’s last wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses on snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests
The 185 km distance crosses the Arctic Circle twice
Start and finish at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix
additional: Participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. A mandatory training camp is required for participants with no experience in extreme cold. Transfers are available from Jockfall to the start area, including transport of pulks. There is no prize purse. Drop bags are not allowed under the rules. The start is at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix, beside the Kalix River. A training course is planned for 2–5 March 2027 and is mandatory for participants with no experience in extreme cold.

name: Edsvidsleden Trailrun
price_range: 50 kr för T-shirt från tidigare år
description: Edsvidsleden Trailrun is a classic trail race in Trollhättan, offering a beautiful and challenging 14 km course along the Edsvidsleden trail. The start and finish are at Forngården, and the course follows a marked hiking trail with some sections additionally flagged. The race is open to everyone who wants to experience trail running on lovely paths, with water available at two stations. It is a well-organised race with a long tradition and a friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 14 km course on the classic Edsvidsleden trail in Trollhättan
The course follows a marked hiking trail, with some sections additionally flagged
Water is available at approximately 9 km and in the start and finish area
additional: The start and finish have been moved to Forngården in Trollhättan. There is no parking at the start; park on the streets in Strömslund or at Torsbovallen. Bring your own water and cup. T-shirts from previous years will be sold on race day for 50 kr each. Course records for men and women are listed for the 14 km, 28 km and 56 km distances from previous years. All participation is at your own risk and permits the publication of photos and videos on social media. The event is a trail race on marked paths, with water stations, no chip timing and a prize ceremony for the top finishers. Participants are advised to bring their own cup and water.

name: Equinox Adventure Ultra
description: Equinox Adventure Ultra is a unique trail-running race held during the spring equinox. The race is a long-distance experience in which teams of two runners navigate on their own and are self-sufficient through equal parts daylight and darkness. Participants can choose between a long distance of at least 100 km or a shorter distance of at least 50 km. The race starts on Saturday at 12:00 and runs until Sunday at 18:00, offering a challenging experience immersed in nature over a full day.
course_highlights: Long-distance trail running through forests and nature
Self-sufficient teams of two runners
Navigation through equal parts daylight and darkness during the spring equinox
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 12:00 until Sunday at 18:00. Each team consists of two self-sufficient runners who must navigate on their own during the race. The race is self-sufficient, with participants using a map and compass to navigate through forests, trails and open landscapes. The start location is secret, and the race takes place around the spring equinox in Nyköping, Sweden.

name: Vårtävlingarna
description: Vårtävlingarna is an annual running race held on the second Saturday in March in Skatås, Gothenburg. The classic course, called “grusåttan” (“the gravel eight”), is just under 8 km long, and participants can choose to run one, two or four laps. Since 2026, Vårtävlingarna Trail has also been offered: a new trail race of approximately 16 km in the Skatås and Delsjö areas. The event offers a well-organised and scenic running experience, with multiple start times and good services in the finish area.
course_highlights: The “grusåttan” course in Skatås, approximately 7,777 metres per lap
Vårtävlingarna Trail: approximately 16 km of trail running, with around one-third gravel road and the rest trail
Water stations and sports drink at the lap point and finish, depending on distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 on race day at Solvikingarna’s clubhouse in Skatås. The start and finish are at the start of the grusåttan course. Changing rooms and showers are available at Skatås Motionscentrum for a fee. A disposable chip is used for timing. The prize ceremony takes place in the finish area after the race. A café is available at Skatås Motionscentrum. Results are published live and officially after the race. Solvikingarna states that Vårtävlingarna is usually held on the second Saturday in March. Vårtävlingarna Trail premiered in 2026.

name: Förslöv Trail
location: Förslövs idrottshall, Förslöv, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Förslöv Trail 2027 is a scenic trail race held at the foot of Hallandsåsen, starting and finishing at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 24 km. Everyone runs the same first 2 km and final kilometre. The race features varied terrain, including forest trails and grass, with beautiful views of the small settlement and the natural landscape on the ridge. After finishing, participants can enjoy a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day or in advance in Båstad, where registered runners receive a discount on Sportshopen’s range.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall
Terrain with forest trails, grass and hills on Hallandsåsen
Sports drink and water available at several stations along the course
additional: Umara sports drink and water are served at several stations, depending on the distance. After the race, participants are offered a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:30 a.m. or in advance at Sportshopen in Båstad, where registered runners receive a 20% discount. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Start times: 24 km at 10:00 a.m., 10 km at 10:30 a.m. and 5 km at 11:00 a.m. Race bibs must be collected on race day at least 20 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports hall, and drinks and refreshments are provided along the course and after the finish.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Annandag Påsk den 29:e mars 2027 är det dags för den 49:e upplagan av Enhörna IF:s Påsksmällen.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual running race held on Easter Monday at Hallaryd School. The race is suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from 1.2 km for the youngest participants to 21 km in the main event. The courses run mostly along gravel roads and paved sections through beautiful landscapes of winding stone walls, meadows and forests on the border between Skåne and Småland. Shorter routes of 3.2 km, 6 km and 9.8 km are also available and are suitable for both running and walking. The event offers timing, water stations and prizes for the top finishers in each class, as well as a plaque for everyone who completes the race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.hallarydsloppet.se/): 2027-03-29 — "Hallarydsloppet 29 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-05)

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Varberg Municipality, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly running event held in the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for those looking for a serious challenge. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has a tradition of welcoming runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Eco Park
Distance options from 1 km to 30 km
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The event is organised by IK Granit. Nordens Ark is a zoo and nature reserve that is open year-round. Parking is free, and there are good bus connections. Participants are encouraged to register well in advance, but current information about registration and prices is not available on the website. The race is cancelled in 2026 but is planned to return in 2027. The event is scheduled to take place on 8 April 2027, with distances from 1 km to 30 km. It is an opportunity for participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in a scenic, family-friendly setting.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan, a popular trail race suited to both elite runners and recreational runners. The race has quickly become a lovely Easter tradition, attracting participants of all ages. Starting and finishing at the ski lodge in Vänersborg, the course offers approximately 7 kilometres of varied running along gravel roads and trails. The first section is easy to run, while the final section is hillier and more challenging. Påskrundan is a celebration of running with a focus on community, and children’s and youth races make it a day for the whole family. Alongside the race, there’s a wonderful atmosphere, prizes for the top finishers in each category, and prize draws for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 kilometres of trail running on gravel roads and trails
The first section is easy and fast to run
The final section is hilly and challenging
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and all participants are entered in prize draws. The start and finish are at the ski lodge in Vänersborg. The race is a celebration of running focused on community, attracting both elite and recreational runners.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden’s fastest 10 km races, run on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. It’s the perfect course for setting a personal best or using as a qualifying result for other races. Welcome to this fast, well-organized race in Skrea-Herting-Hjortsberg.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned
Suitable for setting a personal best and qualifying for other races

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarmilen/): 2027-04-03 — "ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027" (was estimated 2027-03-27)
