name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lkgranslost.se/semesterhalvmaran-finish/): 2027-07-11 — "Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.vikhockey.se/boka-bord-2/city-run/): 2027-07-12 — "Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!" (was estimated 2027-07-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival held every year in Borgholm on Öland. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini, a 1.5 km race for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful views along the shore and an enthusiastic crowd creating a wonderful atmosphere. The event is a popular celebration, with music along the course and a strong commitment to the Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with views along the shore
Music at several locations along the course
Courses adapted for all ages and abilities
additional: Bib pickup takes place on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholms Sporthall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholms Sporthall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive medals, commemorative plaques, ice cream, and drinks, depending on the race. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the parasport categories. There are also parasport and youth categories. Water is available along the 9 km course, and changing rooms and showers are provided at Borgholms Sporthall and Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Fees vary depending on the race and registration date; an administration fee applies.

name: Kraftprovet
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Trollhättans SOK
description: Kraftprovet is a classic city race in Trollhättan, offering a unique running experience along the canal area, with leafy paths, hilly terrain and beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations. The race is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, while cheers from the crowd and music along the course add to the atmosphere. With more than 40 years of tradition, Kraftprovet brings the city, nature and people together during Fallens Dagar. There are several races to choose from, ranging from 800 metres to 11.6 kilometres, including a fun costume competition and an untimed Fun Run category.
course_highlights: The course follows the canal area, with varied and hilly terrain
Beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations
Crowd support, music and a festive atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Start and finish at Hansenplatsen in Trollhättan. A race bib with your first name is available if you register by 30 June. A T-shirt can be ordered when registering by 15 May; it is included in some races and costs extra in others. Runners who finish in under 50 minutes (men) or 55 minutes (women) receive a silver medal. Pacers are available for finish times of 50, 55, 60 and 65 minutes. Costume competition with prizes before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available about 1 km from the finish at Arena Älvhögsborg. Water stations with Umara sports drink and water are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://kraftprovet.se/deltagarinfo/): 2027-07-16 — "Datum 16 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-16)

name: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen
description: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen is a challenging trail race in a mountain setting, with steep climbs, sloping trails and flat meadows offering fantastic views of the mountains. The race combines adrenaline-filled running with scenic experiences and is held at Bruksvallarna ski stadium in Bruksvallarna. This is the fourth edition of the race, welcoming runners to a unique and beautiful challenge in the Swedish mountains.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and sloping trails
Flat meadows with incredible mountain views
A downhill stretch towards Bruksvallarna village after a tough climb
additional: Bib pick-up takes place at the venue in Bruksvallarna. A late-entry fee of SEK 100 applies to registrations on race day. During the week before the race, running clinics, shoe testing, try-out mountain running sessions and other activities are held in Bruksvallarna. Water stations and food and drink stations are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-funasfjallen): 2027-07-17 — "Date 17 juli" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Helags Fjällmara
description: Helags Fjällmara is a classic mountain marathon held in the Ljungdalsfjällen since 1985. The race offers several distances to suit all levels, from the challenging 42 km full marathon to the 800-metre children’s race. It offers a unique mountain experience amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain, and is family-friendly, with races for both adults and children. The start and finish are on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen, and the event includes energy and drink stations, a personal cup, a medal for everyone who finishes, and showers and a sauna after the race.
course_highlights: Trail race amid the beautiful mountain scenery of the Ljungdalsfjällen
Distances ranging from an 800 m children’s race to a 42 km full marathon
Start and finish on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen
additional: Mass start for all distances. Race bibs are distributed at the gymnasium by the event area, with a chip for electronic timing. Energy and drink stations along the course and after the finish. A medal for everyone who finishes. Showers and a sauna are available after the race. Participant caps apply to each distance; for example, 100 participants for the 42 km race. Children under a certain age must run with an adult.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://helagsfjallmara.se/): 2027-07-24 — "24 Juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland countryside. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking class. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: The race goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking class is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth classes have different start times between 15:30 and 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as an untimed walking class. Everyone who finishes receives a medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Bjäre Trail
price_range: 195–425 kr (2026 års ordinarie tidiga anmälningsavgifter; priser för 2027 ej bekräftade)
description: Bjäre Trail is a challenging trail race featuring varied terrain through grazing pastures, old railway embankments and dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls. Runners face steep hills, including an old ski slope, and are rewarded with spectacular views of Laholmsbukten, the northern side of the Bjäre Peninsula and the Halland coastline. The race is held at Båstad Företagsby and welcomes both experienced trail runners and nature lovers looking for a tough, scenic course.
course_highlights: Highly varied terrain with grazing pastures and an old railway embankment
Dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls
Steep hills with views of Laholmsbukten and the Bjäre Peninsula
additional: Maximum 300 starters. Late entries are accepted on site on race day for an additional fee of 100 kr, payable only in even-numbered cash amounts or by SWISH. Bibs must be collected no later than one hour before the start at the start/finish area, or at Bjäre bär’s farm shop on Friday. Toilets are available at Företagsbyn, but there are no changing rooms or showers. Everyone who finishes receives a wooden plaque; winners in each class receive raspberries sponsored by Bjäre bär. Distances are 12, 17, 34 and 51 km. The 34 km and 51 km races consist of two and three laps respectively of the 17 km loop. The race information states a maximum of 300 participants.

name: Hamra Trail Run 2026
description: Hamra Trail Run is a friendly, exclusive trail running event held in spectacular mountain surroundings at Pensionat Strandgården in Fjällnäs. The event offers three distances—Sprint 12 km, Distance 24 km and Ultra 48 km—with varying elevation gain and aid stations along the course. Runners are expected to be self-sufficient and follow the clearly marked orange flags along the route. The event is limited to a maximum of 150 participants and is known for its community spirit and scenic experience.
course_highlights: Sprint 12 km with approximately 300 m of elevation gain and 1 aid station at 4 km
Distance 24 km with approximately 630 m of elevation gain and 2 aid stations at 4 km and 20 km
Ultra 48 km with approximately 1,300 m of elevation gain and 4 aid stations, including at the start/finish
additional: Race bibs are collected at the race office on race day, with different collection times depending on the distance. A mandatory pre-race briefing is held before the start. Runners must bring their own cup/mug/bottle, as disposable cups are not used at the aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes an extra layer, a wind jacket/wind pants depending on the weather, a first-aid kit including an elastic bandage, and a fully charged mobile phone with the safety number saved. Parts of the courses are muddy and unmarked, particularly across Skenörsfjället, where the terrain is dense and rugged. The cut-off time for the 24 km is 3.5 hours, with a maximum time of 8 hours. Runners are encouraged to stop and help others if needed and to follow the flags carefully. GPX files for all distances are available. According to the available race information, the number of entries is limited to 150. A runners’ dinner is held after the finish.

name: ÖTILLÖ Gothenburg
description: ÖTILLÖ Swimrun Gothenburg is a unique swimrun race held at the height of summer in Gothenburg’s beautiful archipelago. The race is rooted in a strong local swimrun tradition and features a spectacular course with numerous swims and varied running terrain across islands and rocks. The event is easy to reach by ferry from the mainland and offers a fantastic combination of nature experiences and spectator support. It is a perfect race for both experienced swimrunners and curious participants who want to experience the sport in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: A combination of fast running sections and intense swims
A course through the West Coast archipelago of Gothenburg, with many islands and islets
Magnificent coastal and archipelago scenery, with plenty of spectators along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: World Series (approx. 39.7 km with 29 running sections and 28 swims), Sprint (approx. 22.8 km with 18 running sections and 17 swims), and Experience. The start and finish are at Styrsö Bratten. Ferries run regularly from Saltholmen and Stenpiren to the event area. Mandatory equipment is available to buy at the start/finish area. A large team of volunteers helps out along the course and at the event. The awards ceremony takes place after the race. Check-in is at Styrsöskolan. The event offers the Experience, Sprint, and World Series distances.

name: Runmaröloppen 2026

tiers.description: Mini-Lunken 1.5km 60kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och en kula glass.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lunken 5.7km: från 150kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Halvmarathon 21km: från 350kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

description: Runmaröloppen is a unique running event in the heart of the Stockholm archipelago on the island of Runmarö. The races offer a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and scenic courses suited to children, seniors and experienced runners alike. The start and finish are at Svängens Krog, and the day offers running, food, ice cream, swimming and a wonderful atmosphere. The half-marathon course is approximately 21 km long and is considered one of Sweden’s most beautiful, while Lunken, at 5.7 km, passes through lush sheep pastures and archipelago villages. Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan are shorter races for children and seniors, and there is also a dog class in which dogs receive an edible medal.
course_highlights: Half-marathon, 21 km around all of Runmarö, with historic and scenic views
Lunken, 5.7 km through lush sheep pastures and authentic archipelago villages
Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan, 1.5 km for children and seniors
additional: The start and finish are at Svängens Krog. Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00, and Lunken and the half-marathon start at 13:00. There are energy stations and encouragement around the island. After finishing, everyone receives a medal and a finisher drink; Mini and Senior Lunk participants are treated to ice cream. There are a maximum of 200 places for the half-marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first release, with another 30 places released later. A dedicated taxi boat runs between Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Styrsvik, as does Vaxholmsbåt route #23. Race bibs can be collected at Svängen and Låttas Bageri. There will be an evening dinner and party at Svängen after the race. 20% of the surplus is donated to Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The event offers children’s races, a 5.7 km race and a 21 km half-marathon. Participant numbers are limited. According to the existing event information, 20 percent of the surplus goes to Skärgårdsstiftelsen.

name: Salomon 27K
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Salomon 27K is a mountain-running event covering 27 kilometres and crossing three mountains, with a beautiful finish in Ottsjö. Many consider it one of Sweden’s most beautiful races, offering a unique mountain experience and pure poetry in nature. Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food are available along the course, and a safety team can provide rapid assistance if needed. Participants can also take a bus transfer to the start and back after the finish.
course_highlights: 27 kilometres of mountain running across three mountains
Beautiful finish in Ottsjö
Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food
additional: Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, as well as a return transfer after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A kåsa drinking cup is used at cup-free drink stations. A safety team is on hand to respond quickly to accidents. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A large portion of the entry fee goes towards upgrading the Fjällmaraton trails for sustainable development. The race is part of Fjällmaratonveckan.

name: Peak Performance Vertical K
description: Åre Vertical K is a prestigious vertical race held annually on Tuesday evening as part of Kia Fjällmaraton Årefjällen. The race starts with a mass start at Åre Torg and finishes at the summit of Åreskutan, gaining exactly 1,000 vertical metres. It is a demanding race, and participants can expect to give their all from start to finish. The course records to beat are 46:24 for women and 39:13 for men. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Mass start at Åre Torg
Finish at the summit of Åreskutan
Exactly 1,000 vertical metres
additional: Food and drink stations along the course featuring local food products. A kåsa is used for serving drinks at cup-free hydration stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and bus transfers back after the finish. Electronic chip timing. Safety team for rapid response in the event of accidents. Entry can be transferred for a fee of SEK 250. Insurance is recommended to cover refunds in the event of illness or injury. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men. The course records are held by Emmie Collinge in 46:24 and Kilian Jornet in 39:13.

name: Fjällmaraton 100k
location: Fångåmon, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton 100K is a classic mountain marathon that starts at dawn in Fångåmon and follows a beautiful, winding, easy-to-run trail to Vålådalen via Nulltjärn. The route then joins the classic Fjällmaraton course over Ottfjället and continues over Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste on the way back to Ottsjö. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with a recovery zone in the finish area where participants can relax in a sauna and recover with non-alcoholic beer. All participants must be self-sufficient during the race, with the option to refill water at official aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Starts at dawn in Fångåmon
Beautiful, easy-to-run trail via Nulltjärn and Vålådalen
Passes over Ottfjället, Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste
additional: Food and aid stations along the course serving local artisanal food. The official drink is U Sport by Umara (lemon). Participants receive a Fold-a-Cup for use at the aid stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and back after the finish. Recovery zone with a sauna and non-alcoholic beer in the finish area. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A safety team is on hand to provide rapid assistance in the event of serious injuries. Participants are responsible for their own fluids and energy between the official aid stations.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 450 kr fram till och med 20:e juli 2027

description: Falkenbergs Stadslopp is a 10 km city race that passes through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery. The race is a community celebration and a running highlight in Halland, welcoming both beginners and experienced runners. The course is fast and easy to run, with fantastic crowd support along the way. The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, creating a smooth and enjoyable overall experience for participants.
course_highlights: 10 km through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery
Fast, easy-to-run course with two water stations along the route
Start and finish at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, with good facilities and crowd support
additional: The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats. A warm-up with Nordic Wellness takes place at 11:40 in the start area. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:00 in the finish area. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia on the Thursday and Friday before the race, and on race day from 9:00. Changing rooms and bag drop are available on race day. Massage is offered in the finish area after the race. Falkenbergs Stadslopp is the 2027 district championship and is part of Tour de Falkenberg. Start groups are marked with flags according to runners’ estimated pace per kilometre, for safety. The kiosk is open 10:00–14:00. There are two water stations on the course, at 3 km and 8 km, as well as one at the finish.

name: Ottsjö 12k
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn i åldern 10 -13 får springa tillsammans med förälder eller annan vuxen och endast betalar 200kr

description: Ottsjö 12K is a 12-kilometer mountain trail race with 300 meters of elevation gain. It offers a beautiful and memorable course without being as demanding as the longer distances during Fjällmaraton Week. The race is a perfect first step for runners who want to challenge themselves in a mountain setting and perhaps later try Salomon 27K or Kia Fjällmaraton. Children aged 10 to 13 can run with an adult at a reduced price, and youths aged 14 to 18 receive half off the entry fee. The race is organized with a focus on sustainability and safety, with food and drink stations along the course and bus transfers to the start and back from the finish.
course_highlights: 12 km of mountain trail with 300 meters of elevation gain
Beautiful and memorable course in a mountain setting
Food and drink stations featuring locally made food along the course
additional: Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and return bus transfers after finishing. Electronic chip timing. Safety organization for a rapid response in case of accidents. A kåsa (traditional drinking cup) is used at cup-free drink stations. Children aged 10–13 can run with an adult. Half price for youths aged 14–18. The standard minimum age is 14. Children aged 10–13 can participate with an adult for 200 kr, and participants aged 14–18 pay half the entry fee. The adult must stay in contact with the accompanying child throughout the race.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, with varied and technically challenging terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers, and after the finish, showers and a light meal are available. This is an ideal race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding woodland trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically challenging terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers. Showers and a light meal are available after the finish. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta; the arrangements, distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Kia Fjällmaraton 45 km
description: Kia Fjällmaraton 45K is a demanding mountain marathon across classic mountain terrain, held during Fjällmaraton Week in the Åre area. The race dates back to 2005, and for 2026 the course is planned to cross Ottfjället along the event’s signature trail. The race welcomes both experienced mountain runners and curious beginners looking for an unusual and scenic challenge. To earn the well-known wooden medal, you must finish within the “medal time” (the winner’s time + 30%); all participants must be self-sufficient on the course.
course_highlights: The course crosses Ottfjället over classic mountain terrain
Food and hydration stations at Edsåsdalen (12 km, 25 km), Tobaksdalen (35.5 km), and Hållvallen (40 km)
Finish in Ottsjö, with a shared post-race lunch for all finishers
additional: Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; the official hydration product at the stations is Umara (2:1 lemon, 120 g/l). Water and toilets are available at the start in Trillevallen. Support along the course is not permitted except at the official stations. In addition to drinks, the stations offer bars, bananas, buns, and, at later stations, hot dogs, coffee, and broth. The race is approximately 45 km long with around 1,200 metres of elevation gain (according to a race report). Participants are self-sufficient between aid stations; official food and hydration are available at Edsåsdalen, Tobaksdalen, and Hållvallen. Kia offers Fjälltransfer, with free transfers between the finish and the parking area, as well as a bus between the finish and Undersåker/Åre. Accommodation in Åre near Kia Fjällmaraton includes, among other options, Hotel Åre Fjällsätra.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a fun run held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå, dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter road route
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer using a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including a floodlit trail and club cabin at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. The start and finish are at Svartå Folkets hus. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail
description: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail is a challenging last-person-standing competition held in scenic Bunketorp in Lindome, south of Gothenburg. Participants run a 6,706-metre course on pleasant, well-trodden forest trails and exercise tracks, with a start every hour on the hour. Each lap must be completed within the hour to continue, and the runner who completes the most laps wins. The course is hilly, with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap, and offers beautiful forest scenery and varied terrain. The event provides a welcoming atmosphere with good service and support for both runners and their companions.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre course on soft forest exercise tracks and trails
A hilly course with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap and three major climbs
Beautiful, varied terrain with no asphalt or gravel roads
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting at the same time. Participants must be in the starting pen at the start and may not cross the start line and then go back. The venue has changing rooms with showers and a sauna, toilets, a participant tent for storage and rest, an aid station, refreshments for companions, secure storage for valuables, and first aid. There is no age limit; participation is at your own risk. Prizes are awarded to the top three women, the top three men, and the best team (3 runners).

name: Nätra Fjällskogslopp
location: Hinnsjöstugan, Nätra fjällskog, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Sweden
description: Nätra Fjällskogslopp is a trail race organised by Nätra GIF youth since 2021. It has quickly become popular and sold out. The race offers four distances: 22 km, 15 km, 9 km and a 2 km children’s race, all through the beautiful and challenging terrain of Nätra Fjällskog. The courses follow trails and forest roads, cross bogs on boardwalks, and offer wonderful nature experiences with views of Hinnsjön and the coastal landscape. The start and finish are at Hinnsjöstugan, and the organisers ask participants to respect the nature reserves along the course.
course_highlights: Beautiful terrain with trails, forest roads and boardwalks across bogs
Climbs up Selshöjden and Västanåhöjden, with views of the coast and Ulvön
A downhill stretch with enchanting views over Hinnsjön
additional: Start times: 22 km at 9:30, 15 km at 9:45, 9 km at 10:00 and 2 km at 10:10. Bibs must be collected by 9:00. A clothes drop-off is available at Hinnsjöstugan. Recommended equipment includes a mobile phone, water/energy supplies and a map of the course. Parking is along the road past Hinnsjöstugan, a short walk from the start. Participants are asked to choose their starting position according to their ability, with those aiming to race at the front. The courses are marked with ribbons in different colours for each distance. Clear course markings and participant support.

name: Istrun - Skaras snabba halvmara
description: Istrun is a fast, flat half marathon in Skara with approximately 70 metres of elevation gain, making it a perfect course for setting personal records. The race is organised by Istrums SK - Friidrott and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners. The distance is 21.1 km, and the course is designed to be fast and easy to run. Runners who are not members of a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association can register through M Motion or K Motion.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Approximately 70 metres of elevation gain
Suitable for personal records
additional: The race is listed as fully booked. For questions or to join the waiting list: istrun@istrumssk.se.

location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: Kivijärviloppet
location: Kivijärvi, Övertorneå Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden
description: Kivijärviloppet is a traditional cross-country race organized by Kivijärvi IF since 1970. The race is held in the village of Kivijärvi in Tornedalen and offers several distances, with a 12 km main event open to both women and men, with no age categories. The race is known for its long history, beautiful courses and generous prize table, thanks to its sponsors. Many well-known athletes have taken part over the years, giving the race strong local and national standing.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with several distances: 0.5 km, 1.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 12 km
Course markers in different colors for each distance: yellow, white, blue and red
The race has used the same courses since it began in 1970, except during Covid
additional: Courses are marked with colors for different distances: 0.5 km and 1.5 km (yellow), 5 km (white), 7.5 km (blue), 12 km (red). The race offers a generous prize table for children, adults and recreational runners, thanks to generous sponsors. Kivijärvi is about 15 kilometers south of Korpilombolo along the Övertorneå road. Information on the official website applies to 2026 and does not confirm the date of August 7, 2027.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
location: Guldsmedshyttan, Lindesberg Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!

name: Kullamilen
organizer: Höganäs Friidrott tillsammans med lokala föreningar
description: Kullamilen is an annual fun run on the Kullahalvön peninsula, welcoming runners, joggers and walkers of all ages and abilities. The races start and finish at the athletics stadium in Höganäs, with distances for children and young people of 2.4 km, as well as 5 km and 10 km for recreational and competitive runners. The courses run largely along the coast, with beautiful sea views, and are sanctioned by the Skåne Athletics Federation. The event is marked by a sense of community, cheerful volunteers and a friendly atmosphere, with the joy of movement at its heart.
course_highlights: The 10 km course follows much of the Kullahalvön coastline and offers sea views
The 5 km and 10 km courses run on asphalt and gravel and are marked and staffed by volunteers
The children’s and youth races take place on the athletics track, covering 6 laps of the 400-metre track
additional: Late registration is available on race day between 09:30 and 11:30 at the race office at the athletics stadium, and no later than 30 minutes before each participant’s start. Bib numbers can be collected from 09:30 on race day. Water stations are located at approximately 3.5 km, 6.2 km and at the finish. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. The 10 km is offered in both competitive and recreational categories. The veterans’ competitive categories are part of the Skåne Veterans Cup.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is a welcoming urban race for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are on Storgatan in the heart of Vetlanda, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course. Younger participants can choose shorter distances from 400 metres up to 1.7 km. The event is a community celebration, with activities and food service in the square, where runners and spectators alike can enjoy a great day together.
course_highlights: Fast loop course in central Vetlanda
Start and finish on Storgatan in the heart of town
Spectator-friendly, with activities and food service in the square
additional: Race bib collection and on-the-day registration take place at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of each class. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are published live and on the OK Njudung website. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hövdingen sports hall near the start/finish. Previous editions have included children’s and youth classes as well as a Funkis class. Race-day bib collection, on-the-day registration and activities have previously been held at Stortorget.

name: BAMM
description: BAMM supported by OMM is a two-day ultramarathon in an Arctic mountain environment, where participants compete in pairs using mountain navigation across vast areas of unmarked terrain. The event offers several classes with different levels of difficulty and distances, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced adventurers. During the competition, participants experience spectacular mountain scenery and challenging navigation, with an overnight stay in the mountains. BAMM is a unique opportunity to combine physical challenge with a nature experience in one of Sweden’s most scenic environments.
course_highlights: Mountain navigation across unmarked terrain
Two-day competition with an overnight stay in the mountains
Arctic mountain environment with vast areas to navigate
additional: Participants compete in pairs (men’s, women’s or mixed teams). Transfers are available from Kiruna Airport to Hotell Riksgränsen and back, with times adapted to flight departures. Riksgränsen railway station is close to the hotel. Accommodation, equipment rental, food and practical information are available via the organiser’s website. The competition is held in teams of two. Mandatory equipment is part of the preparations; for BAMM 30, tents and sleeping bags are transported to the shared overnight camp. OMM is the main sponsor.

name: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon
location: Tavelsjö Church, Tavelsjö, Umeå Municipality, Sweden
description: Tavelsjö Half Marathon is a family-friendly running event offering races for both adults and children. The half marathon starts and finishes at Tavelsjö Church and is a popular goal for summer training. Children can take part in a Mini race, and there is also a timed youth race, making the event a celebration for the whole family. All participants receive a medal and a treat after crossing the finish line, and there are also prize drawings.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting and finishing at Tavelsjö Church
Timed 2.2 km youth race
Mini race for children, popular with the whole family
additional: The youth race starts at 10:00 and is open to young people aged 8–17. Parents are welcome to help children who need support during the youth race. All participants receive a medal and a treat after crossing the finish line. Gift cards are available to purchase as gifts and are delivered within one week of ordering.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a classic night race held on 14 August 2027, with an evening start. The race offers 10 km and 5 km distances, taking participants through the lively streets of Södermalm in a festive atmosphere filled with music, cheers and camaraderie. In addition to the main races, there is also a costume category and children’s races, making the event a festival for all ages. Midnattsloppet is known for its uniquely late start time and the special atmosphere created among runners, spectators and race staff.
course_highlights: The original course around Södermalm in Stockholm
An evening start with a unique night-race atmosphere
A festive atmosphere with music and cheers from spectators along the course
additional: Start times vary by race: the Mini Race (300 m) starts between 11:45 and 15:30, the 2 km children’s races start at 18:30 and 18:50, the 10 km starts at 21:10, the 5 km starts at 21:40, and the costume category starts at 22:00. Corporate races and team competitions are offered to strengthen camaraderie and workplace health. Midnattsloppet is organised by Midnattsloppet Nordic AB, a wholly owned company of Hammarby IF Friidrott, and the surplus goes back to the sports clubs.

name: 6 sjöar
description: 6 Lakes is a race through the beautiful forests just outside Uppsala. You’ll run mainly on small forest roads, with shorter sections of trail. All distances loop around at least one lake, while the full marathon takes you around 6 lakes. With the environment in mind, we provide free bus transport for runners from Uppsala Central Station to the start in Fjällnora, and back after the race. The race is also free of disposable cups; instead, every runner receives a reusable cup.

description:
Welcome to our exciting Åre Run Club x Copperhill loop!

On August 14, runners of all levels will gather to conquer the Copperhill hill. You can choose your own distance—5, 10, 15 or 20 km—and decide for yourself how many laps you want to do before crossing the finish line! We believe everyone should be able to take part and enjoy this amazing experience together. Join us for an unforgettable running celebration, whether you’re a beginner or an experienced runner. Let’s create magical running memories together!

tiers.description: Lilla Blodomloppet för barn upp till 12 år kostar 100 kr och kan anmälas till denna avgift ända fram tills dagen loppet går.

description: Blodomloppet in Jönköping is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also a children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet, for children up to 12 years old, with shorter courses. The event is a social and health-promoting activity where teams and individual participants can take part, and each team receives a picnic bag as part of the entry fee. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational race series, with a strong focus on health and the importance of blood donation.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km runs
Untimed 5 km walk
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old, with 400/800 m courses
additional: Teams can consist of 3–5 participants, and vacant places can be filled at no extra cost until 5 August by email. Registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount when registering. A picnic bag from ICA is included with team registration and can be ordered separately for 250 kr each. Wellness allowances can be used via Wellnet, Epassi or Benify. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old, with shorter 400/800-metre courses. The event raises awareness of the need for blood donation. Participants can form teams, and the event usually ends with a picnic.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Convinistafetten is Sweden’s largest relay race, held annually in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm. Each team consists of five participants, each running 5 kilometres, and there is also a walking category where the team walks together. The event is a fun, energetic evening that promotes team building and company camaraderie. After the race, all teams are treated to a picnic with food, drinks, fruit and coffee on the grass. Convinistafetten has a long tradition dating back to 1986 and attracts over 3,000 teams every year.
course_highlights: Each team runs five legs of 5 km each
Start and finish by the transition zone in Stora Skuggan
A picnic with food and drinks is included after the race
additional: Relay teams start in three different waves, with the first start at approximately 17:30. The walking category starts at approximately 17:40. The team captain receives all the race bibs by mail. The final runner collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. It is possible to book extra picnic boxes and private tent packages to enhance the experience. Title sponsor Convini treats teams to a picnic after they finish.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet in Kalmar is a unique running experience that invites you to walk, jog or run 5 km in a wonderful atmosphere, with music, lighting and surprises along the course. The start and finish are at Stortorget, where runners also pass through on each lap. All participants receive a special medal and, if they register in advance, a unique T-shirt, as well as a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate. The race is open to both men and women, and there is also a walking class without timing. The event is organised by Högby IF with support from Hagbloms and other sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km course with the start, lap point and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
Run at your own pace with music and lighting along the way
A special medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Race number pickup and late registration take place at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday 21 August from 18:00. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Everyone registered by 16 August receives the Nattloppet’s unique T-shirt. Prizes are drawn, including gift cards from Kallskänken. A walking class without timing is available. Open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who finishes receives a medal; participants who register in advance also receive the race’s unique T-shirt.

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget, Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 kr som oavkortat går till Viggo Foundation

description: Askes Fjällmaraton is a child-friendly 1 km mountain race held on Friday evening at Idre Fjäll. The course is well marked and suitable for all children born in 2015 or later. There is no timekeeping, but all participants receive a medal and a treat at the finish. Registration is easy online or on site using Swish, and the entire entry fee goes directly to the Viggo Foundation, which supports neuro-adaptive sports for children and young people.
course_highlights: 1 km course with clear markings
Start and finish at Torget, Idre Fjäll
Child-friendly race with no timekeeping
additional: Registration is available online until 15 minutes before the start or on site at bib collection using Swish. All proceeds go to the Viggo Foundation. After the race, every child receives a medal and a treat. The Fjällmaratonklubben for children aged 4–12 also offers fun activities on Saturday. Intended for children; sources give different age limits. Registration is available online until 15 minutes before the start or on site at bib collection. Proceeds go directly to the Viggo Foundation.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a cross-country relay race held as a festival, where hundreds of teams made up of clubs, companies, families and groups of friends share the classic route from Sälen to Mora. It is the oldest event of the summer and offers a challenging course covering a total of 92 kilometres, divided into ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 kilometres. The race starts in Berga by in Sälen and welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners aged 8 and over. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on the first two legs, and the organiser sends the team captain the race pack with bib numbers and information well in advance of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race between Sälen and Mora
Ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km
Start in Berga by, Sälen, and finish in Mora
additional: The race pack with bib numbers and an information letter is sent to the team captain approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip must be collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen between 06:30 and 08:00. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked, and runners on leg 2 must take the organiser's bus to Smågan. For legs 2 to 10, teams are responsible for their own transport to and from the changeover points.

name: Trail- & Ultravasan (Vasaloppet)
description: Trail & Ultravasan is part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week and offers challenging trail running through forests and hilly terrain in the Vasaloppet Arena. Ultravasan 90 is one of the largest ultramarathons in the Nordic region, covering 90 kilometers from Sälen to Mora. The races attract runners of all ages and levels who want to experience a unique combination of nature, history and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 90 kilometers through forests and hilly terrain
Starts in Sälen and finishes in Mora
Part of Vasaloppet’s historic arena
additional: All participants in Vasaloppet 2027 will receive a ski hat from Craft. Vasaloppet is a non-profit organization owned by IFK Mora and Sälens IF. Ultravasan 90 is one of the largest ultramarathons in the Nordic region and is part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultrarunning event in the scenic surroundings of Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, offering distances of 30, 50 and 100 miles. The race combines physical endurance with community in an intimate setting with a maximum of 100 participants. The course is an 11.8-kilometre loop with aid stations serving food and drink at set times. Runners finish both day and night, with generous time limits for each distance. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good transport links and nearby facilities.
course_highlights: 11.8-kilometre loop course in Lill-Jansskogen
Scenic surroundings with magical forest sections
Aid station with food and drink from Umara served at set times
additional: Maximum 100 participants. Time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles, 16 hours for 50 miles and 9 hours for 30 miles. The 30-mile finish cutoff is 23:00 on Saturday, the 50-mile cutoff is 06:00, and the 100-mile cutoff is 17:00 on Sunday. The start and finish area has parking, toilets, a tent, a restaurant, a 4-H farm and a café. Drinks are provided by Umara. Volunteer opportunities are available. The information states that parking is available at the venue and that it is close to the metro and buses.

name: Trail- & Ultravasan
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 miles, 50 km, 30 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race that challenges you to run the entire classic Vasaloppet route, 92 km from Berga by in Sälen to Mora. The race starts at dawn at 05:00, and you’ll experience beautiful scenery with bright pine forests, marshes, winding waterways and picturesque mountain farmsteads along the way. The race is open to runners aged 17 and over and has a limit of 2,500 participants. It is part of Vasaloppstrippeln and offers generous training grants to the women’s and men’s winners.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by, Sälen
Scenic route through pine forests, marshes and mountain farmsteads
Historic Vasaloppet checkpoints along the entire course
additional: Bib and chip pickup is in Mora or Sälen the day before, or at the start venue. Baggage transport is available to Mora and to Evertsberg (halfway). Starting corrals open at 04:30. Official buses are recommended for transport to the start and from the finish. Maximum 2,500 participants. Elevation gain: 867 m. Training grants of SEK 60,000 for the women’s and men’s winners. The race is open to participants aged 17 and over. Mass start at 05:00 and seven official checkpoints along the course.

name: Fjällvindenterrängen
description: Fjällvindenterrängen is a classic 10-kilometre mountain trail race from Laisaliden to Hemavan. The race takes you through beautiful mountain terrain along Drottningleden and finishes with a run through the ski area, crossing the finish line at the base station of Centrumliften. The race starts at 12:30 with a group warm-up and is limited to 200 participants to ensure a good experience. After the finish, energy, drinks and fruit are provided, and food and fika can be purchased at Anders Bistro. A family evening to get ready for the race is held the night before at Arena Hemavan.
course_highlights: 10 km of mountain terrain along Drottningleden
Crossing Mortsbäcken, followed by a steep, technical downhill section
The final stretch runs through the ski area, descending to the finish
additional: A bus to the start is included, departing at 11:30 from the Centrumhuset car park in Hemavan. There is a water station after approximately 5–6 km. Timing chips are handed out at the start and must be returned after the finish. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 13:30 in the finish area. Warm-up clothes can be left at the start to be transported to the finish. Toilets are available in Centrumhuset, but there are no showers. There is an outdoor toilet at the start. Start at 12:30 with a group warm-up. Limited to 200 participants; the entry fee includes bus transport to the start and energy at the finish.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås

tiers.label: tier_2

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run the 5 km or 10 km distances, and there is also a special Lilla Blodomloppet for children. The race is open to both individual participants and teams, and concludes with a shared picnic. The course runs through the Rocklunda area, with clear course markings and flag marshals along the route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklunda, on the football fields north of the riding arena
Marked courses with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter routes around Rocklunda IP
additional: The event offers individual and team registration (teams of 3–5 people), with a picnic for teams. Lilla Blodomloppet has two children's distances (approx. 1,400 m and approx. 500 m), and participants choose their distance on site. The warm-up takes place at approx. 17:00 in front of the stage. All participants receive a medal and a finish-line bag from ICA Maxi Hälla. The courses are marked, and there are water stations. Registration is binding, and cancellations are not accepted.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis anmälan för alla barn och ungdomar.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running event held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, with a course that passes through classic surroundings, lined with cheering spectators and featuring more than ten music stations to create a wonderful atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. Children can also take part in the free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, lined with cheering spectators
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 in four waves and is free for children. The children’s warm-up is led by Friskis & Svettis at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race starts at 19:30, with warm-ups 15 minutes before each start. Race numbers can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered water drilled by Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is by chip, and results are published directly after the finish. ARQLY-Spurten is a race within the race on the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet is free for children.

name: GKN-stafetten 2026 (del av Trollhättan Action Week)
description: The GKN Relay is a relay race held along the Trollhättan Canal during Trollhättan Action Week. Each team consists of four participants, each running 3 kilometres on a flat course around the canal. The event is full of team spirit and energy, with live music and an evening of fun and camaraderie. Participants can pick up their race bibs and relay baton the day before to avoid queues. After the race, there is an opportunity to enjoy a picnic and entertainment at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat course around the Trollhättan Canal
Team relay with 4 participants, 3 km per leg
Running combined with live music and a picnic at the finish
additional: Race bibs and the relay baton can be collected the day before at Odenhuset. NearYou offers a staffing pool to cover late withdrawals from teams. After the race, there is live music and the opportunity to picnic at the finish area. Race bibs and the relay baton can be collected the day before the race.

name: Höga Kusten Trail
description: Höga Kusten Trail is one of Sweden’s most popular adventure races, offering a weekend filled with spectacular nature, camaraderie and celebration in the World Heritage Site of Höga Kusten. The event features five unique distances over two days, ranging from 14 km to 60 km, giving participants the chance to experience some of Höga Kusten’s most iconic peaks and views. Alongside the races, race briefings, gear exhibitions and cosy after-trail events create a great running festival for all levels. Höga Kusten Trail is more than just a race—it’s a complete experience focused on nature, community and adventure.
course_highlights: Five unique distances through the World Heritage Site of Höga Kusten
Running, jogging and fast hiking across dramatic peaks and beautiful landscapes
After-trail celebrations with a live band and a sense of community
additional: The races take place over two days, with five distances. On Friday, Three Peaks 18k and Coast to Summits 28k start; on Saturday, Twin Peaks 14k, The Original 45k and The Ultimate 60k start. Race briefings are held before each distance, and after-trail events feature a live band and a sense of community. Buses run from FriluftsByn to the start locations. Participants can sell their entry to someone else if they are ill. Gear exhibitions from Icebug and Haglöfs are on site. Friday’s races are Three Peaks 18 km and Coast to Summits 28 km. Saturday’s races are Twin Peaks 14 km, The Original 45 km and The Ultimate 60 km. Registration for 2027 opens on Friday, 5 March at 15:00.

name: Istrun
description: Istrun Half Marathon is a flat and fast course (approx. 70 m elevation gain), officially measured and approved by SFIF, offering ideal conditions for setting a half marathon personal best.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place on 29 August 2026, with beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned to reduce the total elevation gain while retaining a varied profile with sections through nature, crowd support and several power zones; the marathon course finishes with a spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge. The race attracts international participants and also features shorter races and a MINI children’s race, as well as offers for businesses and tent packages in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna, on a redesigned course with less elevation gain
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 aid stations along the course plus 1 in the start/finish area, an interactive map and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: up to five runners can be registered at a time; race bibs are not sent out. The marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and 12+1 aid stations. The organizer offers tent packages for businesses in the start/finish area and the option to use a wellness allowance. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes a team relay and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and aid stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a business village with tents in the start/finish area.

name: Stockholm Trail
description: Stockholm Trail is a trail race organised by OK Södertörn, offering a unique running experience in the beautiful Nackareservatet, just outside Stockholm City. The races follow winding forest trails and cross sunlit rock slabs, with courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with encouraging marshals and personal service. All proceeds from the race go directly to OK Södertörn’s activities.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely through nature, along technical forest trails and over beautiful rock slabs
Fantastic views and unique natural areas in Nackareservatet
Clearly marked courses with encouraging marshals along the way
additional: There are six different courses: 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K fun run (untimed), 2.5K kids, and Mini Trail for the very youngest participants. All participants receive a race bib with their name and a unique medal after completing the race. Showers and changing facilities are available at the venue. The course requires shoes with good grip and careful attention to roots and rocks. The 21K has a generous time limit to suit all runners.

name: Säve Trail Run
description:
Säve Trail Run 2027 

After a wonderful inaugural event in 2026, Säve Trail Run returns on 28 August 2027. We look forward to another day filled with the joy of running, community and wonderful nature experiences in Säve, north of Gothenburg. 

Säve Trail Run takes you through beautiful woodland, winding trails, soft pine-needle carpets and varied terrain. The route combines easy-running sections with technical features that give you that wonderful trail-running feel—whether you’re an experienced trail runner or trying it for the first time.

Choose the distance that suits you best: 12 km, 7 km or 2 km for children and beginners. 

The start and finish are at Säve Sportklubb, where runners, families and spectators gather for a day of exercise, joy and community.

All participants receive a medal to remember the event, and great prizes are promised for the podium finishers in each distance.

Säve Trail Run is for everyone. Whether you’re chasing a rush, want to challenge yourself or simply enjoy nature and the experience with others.

More information about Säve Trail Run 2027, including the race date, course profiles, maps and practical details, will be published on the website as it becomes available.

See you on 28 August 2027

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a unique half marathon that takes runners through central Stockholm. The course is easy to run and passes through areas including Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The start and finish are by the Royal Palace, and after the race there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. The race offers a historic and beautiful running experience in the heart of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Unique course through central Stockholm
Passes through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Start and finish by the Royal Palace
additional: Race kit pick-up and Expo in Kungsträdgården, 27–29 August. After-run event in Kungsträdgården after the finish. An after-run event in Kungsträdgården and distribution of participant materials there on the days before the race, as stated in the existing race information.

name: Midnattsloppet (Malmö)
description: Midnattsloppet Malmö is a festive, high-energy running experience taking place on 28 August 2027. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, both starting late in the evening to create a unique atmosphere with music, spectators and a carnival spirit along the course. The race is known for its community spirit and the joy of movement, and also offers team and corporate competitions to strengthen team spirit. Midnattsloppet is organised in collaboration with Malmö Allmänna Idrottsförening and is part of a larger Nordic running festival.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km road races in central Malmö
Late-evening starts at 21:00 (10 km) and 22:30 (5 km)
Carnival atmosphere with music and spectators along the course
additional: Fancy-dress starts for the 10 km and 5 km at 21:12 and 22:36, respectively. The 10 km time limit is 90 minutes, with a cutoff at 6.6 km at 22:27. Wellness allowances can be used via Benifex, Epassi and Benefits. A race pack and T-shirt are included in the registration. An After Run event with wraps and drinks is available after the race from 23:00 to 01:00.

name: Midnattsloppet
description: Midnattsloppet Malmö is a festive night race taking place on 28 August 2027, with distances of 5 km and 10 km. The race starts late in the evening and offers a unique atmosphere, with thousands of runners and spectators creating an energetic celebration in the heart of the city. In addition to the regular races, there are also costume races and corporate competitions, adding to the sense of community and making the evening a memorable experience. Midnattsloppet is known for the joy of movement, its carnival atmosphere, and the opportunity to run together in teams or with colleagues.
course_highlights: Night race with starts at 21:00 (10 km) and 22:30 (5 km)
The race runs on paved roads in central Malmö, with a carnival atmosphere and support from spectators
Option to take part in costume races and corporate competitions
additional: Costume races start at 21:12 (10 km) and 22:36 (5 km). Corporate and team competitions are offered to strengthen community and team spirit. Hotel offer with a 20% discount on overnight accommodation, breakfast buffet, and late checkout. After Run event with wraps and drinks after the race, from 23:00 to 01:00. 10 km runners receive timing, water along the course, refreshments after the finish, a Björn Borg T-shirt, and a digital diploma. A medal can be purchased separately. The 10 km category offers prize money for the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Trelleborgsloppet
description: Trelleborgsloppet is a classic city race in Sweden’s southernmost town, featuring certified, officially measured courses. The event offers 10 km and 5 km races for runners, as well as a 5 km walk/power walk. The start is at Östervångsstadion and the finish is in Stadsparken. The race uses gun time and disposable timing chips, and welcomes competitive runners, corporate teams and recreational runners alike. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and there is a team competition for companies, associations and groups of friends.

name: Festivalloppet

late_fee.price: ordinarie anmälningsavgift + 60 kr för alla över 16 år

description: Festivalloppet is an annual running race organized in Strömsnäsbruk by SK Graal. The race offers a pleasant competitive environment for runners of different ages and abilities, with the option to register on race day. SK Graal is an active club that also offers training and member benefits such as discounts on running shoes. Festivalloppet is part of the club’s wide range of events and attracts runners from the local area.
additional: Late registration is available on race day up to one hour before each start. Payment can be made in cash or by Swish. There is no late registration fee for children, young people, or the walking class. Clubs registering more than 5 participants can email a registration list and will be invoiced afterward.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026
description: Rynningeviken Längre is a running race in Örebro offering a unique challenge: participants run as far as they can in three or six hours. The race follows scenic trails along Lake Hjälmaren and the Svartån River in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve, close to the city centre. The focus is on endurance rather than speed, giving runners the chance to set personal distance records in beautiful surroundings. There is also a KidsRun for children born in 2014 or later, where they can run a shorter course and receive a medal, with no timing.
course_highlights: A 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly on gravel paths
Two bridges, with little elevation gain, and cobblestones in the start/finish area
A shorter 508-metre loop used during the final 15–30 minutes for faster final distance measurements
additional: Start times: 6-hour race at 11:00, 3-hour race at 14:00, KidsRun at 11:30. A mandatory race briefing takes place 15 minutes before the start. There is no timing; distance is measured using a transponder worn around the foot and loaned to participants. Energy partner Umara provides sports drinks and an energy table with bars, fruit, crisps, pickles, toscakaka and coffee from Cozo Coffee. Public toilets are available near the start area and after approximately 1 km. Changing facilities and showers are not provided, but swimming is possible in the Svartån River. You can change your distance after registering by emailing the organisers no later than three days before the race.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a celebration for both competitive recreational athletes and casual runners who want to challenge themselves in three different events: skiing, cycling and running. The running event offers distances of 21 km and 12 km, as well as children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m. Kraftloppet focuses on health and wellbeing and community, and offers the opportunity to take part in the Kraft Classic by completing all three events in the same calendar year.
course_highlights: Running distances of 21 km and 12 km, plus children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m
A recreational event with shorter and longer distances for different ages and ability levels
Part of the Kraft Classic, which includes skiing, cycling and running in the same year
additional: The Kraft Classic rewards participants who complete Kraftloppet skiing, Kraftloppet cycling and Kraftloppet running in the same calendar year. Registration is available via links on the registration page. Contact Bergsbyns SK by phone at +46 (0)910-861 61 or by email at info@kraftloppet.com.

name: Dundret Extreme Running
description: Dundret Extreme Running (DXR) is a challenging recreational race held in late August on Dundret in Gällivare. The race has a long history, dating back to its launch in 1997, and offers several distances across varied terrain, including sections of cross-country terrain and bog running. The longest course is 22 km with approximately 700 metres of elevation gain.
