Runners climb to the mountain prize at the summit of Dundret, where the mast is located, then run around the peaks before finishing at Hellnerstadion. DXR is a race for runners looking to test their endurance and enjoy beautiful mountain scenery.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Sweden
description: Vikingatrailen is a trail race organized by Årsunda IF, starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The race offers several courses of varying lengths and terrain, including a 1 km mini race. The event has been well received, with many participants praising the organization. Participants can access maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles for the courses in advance. Vikingatrailen is a family-friendly running experience close to nature in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård)
Several courses of 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Courses available as GPX files with elevation profiles
additional: The mini race starts 1 km from the finish, with bus transport to the start. Results and photos are published after the race. The courses are listed as public routes in Garmin Connect. Maps and GPX files are available for the courses.

name: Blodomloppet (Borås)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 11 augusti)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 11 augusti)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km promenad 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 11 augusti)

description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children and a sociable atmosphere with team registration and a picnic bag. The course is hilly and runs through beautiful natural surroundings near Ymergården, making the event both challenging and scenic. It is a popular fitness activity for individuals and teams alike, with a focus on community and health.
course_highlights: 5 km run/walk on walking-friendly trails in hilly terrain
10 km run on hilly trails and roads between Ymer and Kype, with a new route
Lilla Blodomloppet – a child-friendly course where children can run, hop or walk
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register, with a picnic bag included. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event until one hour before the start, for an increased fee. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August at the latest. Late registration at the event area opens at 16:00. An activity trail called Jätten Ymers Stig is located in the area. According to the existing race information, participants receive a T-shirt and a medal.

name: Blodomloppet
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational race that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in the beautiful Linnéparken and features a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, on a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social health and fitness activity for both individual participants and teams, and ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; two laps for 10 km
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available in person at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. Water stations are located along the course. The race ends with a shared picnic for participants. Lilla Blodomloppet is available for children. Participants can register individually or as part of a team.

name: Blodomloppet Halmstad

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 750 kr för lag med upptill fem deltagare inkl. picknickkasse t.o.m 11/8

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr Lilla Blodomloppet Sista anmälningsdag är den 25 augusti för lag

description: Blodomloppet in Halmstad is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to participants of all ages and abilities, both individually and in teams, and ends with a shared picnic. It is a social and healthy activity with an important purpose, organised by Halmstad Orienteering Club in collaboration with the blood donation centres in Halland.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in Halmstad
Lilla Blodomloppet for children and young people
Water stations along the course
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team. Team registration includes a picnic bag. Food, drinks and ice cream are available to buy at the start. Companies and teams can rent tents in the finish area, which overlooks the sea. Bib numbers, changing facilities, toilets and storage are available. Registration is online only via the website. Fitness allowances are accepted. There are water stations along the course. A playlist is associated with the event. Lilla Blodomloppet is available for children.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
location: Ramsviks Camping, Ramsvik, Sotenäs Municipality, Sweden
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a unique multi-stage trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Ramsvik in Bohuslän. Over three days, participants experience a total of 77 kilometres across varied terrain featuring massive cliffs, narrow forest trails, coastal communities and beautiful beaches. The race offers different start groups for walkers, joggers and runners, making it an experience for all levels. Alongside the race, there are activities for children at Kids Camp and accommodation options close to the sea at Race Village. It is a highlight for anyone looking to combine a challenge with spectacular nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 77 kilometres of trail over three days, in stages
Massive cliffs, narrow forest trails and beautiful beaches
Start groups for walkers, joggers and runners
additional: Participants use the Pace+ app for race tickets, start times, schedules and maps. The official accommodation partner is Ramsvik Stugby & Camping by the sea, where Race Village and post-finish activities are also located. During the race, Kids Camp offers activities for children such as sailing, fishing and a visit to Nordens Ark. Race Village is located at Ramsviks Camping. Accommodation is booked separately; Ramsvik offers accommodation packages with a cottage, breakfast and dinner. Kids Camp is available for children aged 6 and over.

name: Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg is a festive and popular night race held on August 21, 2027, with distances of 5.2 km and 10 km. The race starts at Gustaf Adolfs Torg and offers a unique atmosphere with late start times, music, and crowd support along the course. Midnattsloppet is about the joy of running, community, and celebration, as well as competitive spirit for the fastest runners. It is a festival that brings together runners of all ages and abilities in central Gothenburg.
course_highlights: Night race starting at Gustaf Adolfs Torg
10 km and 5.2 km distances through central Gothenburg
Festive atmosphere with music and crowds along the course
additional: Start times: The 10 km starts at 21:15, and the 5.2 km starts at 22:54. A costume start is available for both distances. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes from the last start group. Start and finish at Gustaf Adolfs Torg. The entry fee includes timing, water along the course, Vitamin Well, a bar and fruit after the finish, and a digital diploma. A Björn Borg T-shirt is included. Registration through wellness benefit providers is available. A corporate competition and team competition are offered. Prize money is awarded to the top 3 in the 10 km category. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km. The event is an evening race with late start times.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon is a certified World Athletics Road Race that takes runners through Helsingborg’s historic city centre, scenic areas and along the beautiful seafront promenade, with views of the Öresund. The race starts at Sundstorget outside Dunkers Kulturhus, and the course offers a varied, scenic running experience with a total elevation gain of just 95 metres. It is perfect for runners who want to combine city running with nature and a seaside setting. With three start waves, race day is smooth and well organised for up to 4,000 participants.
course_highlights: Start at Sundstorget outside Dunkers Kulturhus
Run through Helsingborg’s historic city centre and past Kärnan
Seafront promenade with views of the Öresund
additional: The start is divided into three waves: 09:30, 09:33 and 09:36. The course has a total elevation gain of 95 metres, with a hill up towards Kärnan after 2 km and a long downhill towards the sea after 19 km. A maximum of 4,000 starting places are available.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is Gothenburg’s largest trail race, offering five challenging distances through beautiful and varied terrain close to the city. The routes follow adventurous trails through lush forests and over rocky outcrops with fantastic views, combining technical sections with easier running. The start and finish are at historic Kvibergs Park, and the courses take you from the outskirts of the city into the wilderness, with lakes and magical forests along the way. After the finish, a convivial AfterRun with food and energy awaits to celebrate your achievement. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners looking for a real outdoor challenge close to Gothenburg.
course_highlights: A varied mix of technical and easier trails through lush forests and over rocky outcrops
Pass by idyllic lakes and magical forests, with historic stone cairns along the way
Start and finish at Kvibergs Park, with views over Gothenburg and the Säveå valley
additional: Start and finish at Kvibergs Park. The 33 km race starts at Angered Church, with a shared bus from Kviberg. Self-seeding in start groups on site. AfterRun with food and energy after the finish. Live tracking and intermediate times. Mandatory equipment is required. Bib pickup takes place on Friday and Saturday before the race. Public transport by tram and bus to Kviberg is recommended. Name changes are possible for a fee until 3 September. A children’s race is available as a supplementary activity. The race takes place on 4 September 2027. Longer distances require, among other things, a water container of at least 0.5 litres, energy, and a charged mobile phone. Public transport is recommended, and paid parking is available.

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a challenging and scenic trail run through the forests and countryside around Dammen in Tvärred, just south of Ulricehamn. Participants can choose from three distances: 7 km, 17 km and 27 km, all starting and finishing in the same beautiful area. The course features narrow forest trails, moss-covered rocky sections and magical views over Åsunden, making the race an adventure filled with camaraderie and the joy of running. Hot food is served after the finish, and all participants receive a medal. The youngest runners can take part in a free mini race focused on fun and play.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and hilly terrain
Moss-covered rocky sections and exposed rock slabs
Beautiful views over Åsunden
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred. Parking is available nearby. Food and drinks, music and sun loungers are available on site. Volunteers and an announcer help spectators follow the highlights of the race. Hot food is included for all participants after the finish. The free mini race for children starts at 10:45, with registration on site. Maximum 300 participants. The entry fee is the same for all distances. Reduced fees for children and young people. The Västgötaloppet website lists 5 September 2026 as race day, which differs from the date 4 September 2027 in the competition information.

name: LöpRallarn
description: LöpRallarn is a running race organized by Bottnaryds IF at Bottnaryds IP. The race offers distances of 7.5 km and 15 km, with a course that includes loops through varied terrain. The event attracts both young and adult runners and has a wonderful late-summer atmosphere with an energetic field of runners. The race is part of Rallarloppen and has a tradition of bringing together many participants each year.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course and a 15 km loop
Varied terrain with different loops
Start and finish at Bottnaryds IP
additional: The race has a strong field, with many young and adult participants. Results and contact: christian.wigren@rallarloppet.se. The race is held alongside other Rallarloppen events and has a tradition of taking place in late summer. The 2027 race is scheduled for 5 September. The organizer's information mentions refreshment stations and a mountain prize.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic route along the riverside promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a communal picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km routes along the riverside promenade and city streets
Measured 5,000 m course by an SFIF certified course measurer
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams of 3–5 participants, with a picnic for 5 people included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter routes inside the park. The course is measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. The event raises awareness of blood donation and has a picnic tradition. Registration is usually available individually or in teams.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultra; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many short, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many short hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire and BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp every lap; there are special features for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The cut-off for the 24-hour ultra is stated as Sunday 6.09.2026. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support is available to help find a night-running buddy for dark laps. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate via the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet is a traditional running race held at Billingen in Skövde. The race offers several distances, including 8.8 km, 4.4 km, 2.5 km, and a children’s race for the youngest participants. The spectator-friendly course consists of two loops, with the start and finish at the ski stadium. The event is marked by a wonderful spirit of running and has a long history, attracting many participants from different age groups.
course_highlights: The course is 4.4 km long and consists of two loops
Start and finish at the ski stadium on Billingen
Spectator-friendly course with clear markings and course marshals
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the ski stadium from 10:00 and no later than 30 minutes before the start. Timing is done with a chip attached to the race number. Water is available at the lap point and finish. All finishers receive a medal. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in different categories. Late registration is available on race day from 10:00 until 45 minutes before the start. Refreshments are available near the finish. Parking is at the main car park in the Billingen Recreation Area.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a fun run offering a unique experience in nature and a challenge, with three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and times are recorded for all distances. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to combine performance with an experience in nature.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: The mass start is from Gränna Square, going through the town to the harbor, where timing begins. Timing and a unique medal for all participants. The race venue is in the heart of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
location: Ästad Vingård, Tvååker, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra is a unique trail race held at Ästad Vingård. The race follows a 6.7 km loop through beautiful surroundings, with a start every hour on the hour. Participants run lap after lap until only one runner remains, creating an exciting and challenging race format. The event offers a wonderful atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy Ästad Vingård’s scenic surroundings over an entire weekend.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the beautiful surroundings of Ästad Vingård
A start every hour on the hour, with runners completing laps until only one remains
Scenic views of beech forests, spruce forests and bogs
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00. Anyone who does not complete the course before the next start is out of the race. The race continues until only one participant remains, and that runner completes a final solo lap. The loop course increases safety, makes the race spectator-friendly and allows runners to change equipment at the end of each lap. The event encourages community and respect for nature. The first start is at 09:00. The race continues until one participant remains, and that runner completes a final lap.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset nature reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across bogs and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. The distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is known for its strong sense of community and festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding trails, bogs and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. There is a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The terrain is challenging and gives runners a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational race that has been held in Saltsjö-Duvnäs since 2007. The race is primarily intended for residents of Nacka, Värmdö and Saltsjöbaden, but welcomes other participants too. The start and finish are in Ringparken, and the race has strong local roots, with a focus on preserving its character as a family event for all ages. In 2027, the race celebrates 20 years with new start categories and continued community spirit among neighbours and runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ringparken in Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Courses of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km course)
The course features varied terrain with hills, a waterfront promenade and views around Duvnäs Udde
additional: Timing chips are now integrated into the race bib. Race administration opens the day before and on race day. Participant numbers are limited to preserve the family atmosphere. The children’s race has its own short course around Ringparken.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park och Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a relay race for teams of 2–4 people, held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The course is approximately 5.4 km long and winds through areas including ESS and Kunskapsparken, on a mix of asphalt and gravel. The relay is part of Innovationsloppet & stafetten, where participants kick off autumn together with an energy boost in a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere. The races celebrate Lund as a city of innovation and are organised in partnership by IFK Lund Friidrott and Ideon Science Park.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km and runs from Nobelparken via ESS and Kunskapsparken
A mix of asphalt and gravel, with a flat course and approximately 10 metres of elevation difference
Views of northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams can be women's, men's or mixed teams of 2–4 people, and runners may run more than one leg. The start and finish are in Nobelparken in Brunnshög. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal or a sausage. The competition area is easily accessible by tram and bus. Teams compete in women's, men's or mixed categories. Each runner runs approximately 5 km.

name: Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running and recreational race organized by Lidköpings VSK since the late 1960s. The race takes place in Råda and offers classes and distances of up to 18 km. It is usually held on the second Saturday in September and is a welcome event for runners of all ages. The Paprikaloppet for children is often held on the same day in partnership with Ica Hjertbergs.
course_highlights: Run in scenic Råda
Classes and distances of up to 18 km
Traditionally held on the second Saturday in September
additional: Rådalunken is held together with the Paprikaloppet for children on the same day. The race offers classes and distances of up to 18 km. The event is part of Lidköpings VSK’s annual competition program. Previous editions have offered the Papricaloppet for younger children. Timing has been handled by C-time, and Umara sports drink has been served.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

price_tiers.distance: Mini Kung Björn (barn upp till 7 år)
Lilla Kung Björn (barn upp till 12 år)
10 km, 6 km och Trail ca 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälan sista veckan 345 kr för samtliga klasser

description: Kung Björn Loppet is a trail race in Uppsala that welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages, with families at its heart. The race is held at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances, including a children’s race, 6 km, 10 km and a trail race of approximately 5 km. The courses consist of gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt, with water stations along the longer distances. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants.
course_highlights: Trail race on gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt
Courses of approximately 10 km and 6 km, plus a trail race of approximately 5 km
Two water stations on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course
additional: Race bibs with electronic chips can be collected from Löplabbet the day before race day or on race day from 09:00. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the event site, but space is limited. A kiosk sells drinks, hot dogs and baked goods. Start groups are available for the 10 km, with a choice of faster and slower groups. Paid parking is available, but public transport and cycling are recommended. The event includes race-bib collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony.

name: Kistaloppet
description: Kistaloppet is a family-friendly urban running event organized by Löparakademin, with races for all ages: Kistaloppet 5 km, Lilla Kistaloppet/Fun Run 1.6 km, and Kistaloppet MINI for the youngest runners. The courses offer a varied running experience through the Million Programme’s high-rise buildings, the green spaces of Järvafältet, and Kista’s IT cluster, with the start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg, next to Kista Galleria. The event emphasizes accessibility and community, including the #RUN4ZERO initiative, and is designed both for recreational runners and for those who want to compete on the certified 5 km course. The event is usually complemented by music, entertainment, and a festive atmosphere along the course.

name: Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Kretsloppet in Borås is a street festival where runners of all ages are invited to run 5 km or 10 km through the city’s streets and parks. The youngest participants can take part in children’s races (400 m and 2 km), and the event finishes in the heart of Borås, in the city centre/city park. The event welcomes both experienced runners and recreational runners, and encourages people to participate in groups with family, friends or colleagues. The organizer’s text evokes the cheerful atmosphere, with music, cheers from the crowd and activities around the race.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås, offered over several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a varied 10-mile (16.1 km) loop featuring technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, a hiking trail and sections of asphalt. The race is organized by Västerås Löparklubb, with rewards including a medal for completing the race and a belt buckle for completing 100 miles in under 24 hours.

name: Lergöksloppet
description: Lergöksloppet is a recreational race organized by FK Snapphanarna on winding trails and forest roads in the beautiful Kronoskogen in Ängelholm. The start and finish are at Råbocka Camping, and the race welcomes children, recreational runners and competitive runners alike. After finishing, participants receive a medal, and fruit and juice or coffee and tea with a sandwich are served, depending on the class. Shower and changing facilities are limited, and registration is also available on race day for an extra fee.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast and scenic half marathon along a former railway embankment between Forshaga and Karlstad. The route is entirely traffic-free and has no steep climbs. The race is certified by the Swedish Athletics Association and offers three aid stations with water and sports drinks along the course. The race starts at Forshaga Lärcenter and finishes in Karlstad, where participants are treated to fruit and refreshments after the finish. It is a popular race that attracts many runners looking to set a personal best in beautiful surroundings.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a trail race through central Trollhättan that began in 2016. Starting at Folkets Park, the race takes runners through varied terrain, including urban surroundings, hilly trails, stairs and scenic areas such as Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, several locks, Olidan and Kungsgrottan. There are several distances to choose from, from a short, child-friendly Mini Trail to longer, challenging courses of up to 22.5 km. The race also offers start classes for running with a dog on certain distances, making it an inclusive event with a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: A trail race featuring hilly paths and pulse-raising stairways
Passes several locks, Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, Olidan and Kungsgrottan
A mix of urban surroundings and nature experiences
additional: Bib distribution opens at 11:30. Start times: 13:00 for Mini Trail 0.8 km; 14:00 for City Trail 8.5, 14 and 22.5 km; and 14:15 for City Trail 8.5 and 14 km with dogs on a leash. The awards ceremony takes place about 30 minutes after the first finisher crosses the line. The race offers dedicated start groups for running with a dog on a leash in the 8.5 km and 14 km races. Mini Trail is a children’s race for ages 0–12, with no timing or competition. Start and finish at Folkets Park. Previous editions have offered 8.5 km, 14 km and 22.5 km, as well as Trollhättan Mini Trail at approximately 0.8 km. The distances and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race dating back to 1966, organized by IFK Skövde Skidor. The race has historically featured varying distances, but since 1993 both men and women have competed over 10.5 km. There are also categories for younger participants, such as Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet, as well as a Nordic walking category for recreational participants. Over the years, the race has attracted many well-known Swedish runners and is a popular event in Skövde.
course_highlights: A cross-country race with a rich tradition dating back to 1966
A 10.5 km race for both men and women since 1993
Categories for younger runners and Nordic walking
additional: New categories for younger participants are available, including Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet. There is also a Nordic walking category for those who prefer it. Course records are documented for men and women over 10.5 km, as well as for older distances. There is also a Nordic walking category for recreational participants.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a popular fun run held in Linköping, starting and finishing at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race offers a pleasant course through the central parts of the city and a great running experience for both recreational and competitive runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good amenities, including changing rooms, showers and bag drop. It is a traditional autumn race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course passes through central Linköping, with lovely views
Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen
Paved surface with gentle undulations
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. A bag drop is offered. Food and drink, as well as medical assistance, are available on site. Bib numbers and race confirmations are handled according to the terms and conditions. It is possible to transfer an entry and change category. The race also seeks volunteers.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and ability levels. The main event is a 10 km fun run along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest participants. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The event venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race bib collection and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet has start times from 09:15 to 10:15 for different age groups. The Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45 and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition; details about the 2027 event format and registration have not been confirmed.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025
location: Rya Åsar Nature Reserve, Borås, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 745 kr 28 september – 3 oktober – i mån av plats!

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a popular trail race in Borås, offering beautiful and varied terrain in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve. The race has several distances to suit both beginners and experienced trail runners, with challenging hills and lovely views. The start and finish area has a great atmosphere, with music, exhibitors, food and a runners’ lounge. The event has a family-friendly feel, with children’s races and a festival atmosphere in the forest that attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Varied trail running on beautiful paths with challenging hills
Djävulsbacken—a 300 m-long hill with 75 m of elevation gain
Beautiful views at Rya Klint, Fjällsjön and Hestrastugan
additional: Start and finish on the plateau at Rya Åsar, with music, exhibitors, a runners’ lounge and food service. Bib collection on Friday and Saturday. Chip timing, with start groups for elite, fast runners and recreational runners. Bag drop available. Toilets, changing facilities and showers at Borås Camping. Aid stations with Umara sports drink on the 24 km and 12 km courses. Children’s races of 800 m and 1.8 km are available. Children’s races and sanctioned competitions are offered.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with 300, 600 and 1,500 metres of elevation gain respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance taking runners up the mountain five times. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and demanding trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails in untouched wilderness
Beautiful views by small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children’s race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Transfer of a race entry is possible under the terms listed on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, plus VMX Kids. Trail running shoes are recommended. The website describes the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund to TanumStrand, Tanum Municipality, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand and the final race in the Outnorth Trailtour. The race offers a scenic course with cliffs, jetties, the scent of seaweed and views that soothe the mind while the body works hard. Sweden’s trail-running elite gather here for exciting races in a unique setting where mountains, forest and sea meet. Participants can also extend the experience with accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Scenic views featuring cliffs, jetties and the scent of seaweed
Part of the Outnorth Trailtour, featuring Sweden’s trail-running elite
additional: Accommodation and a banquet are offered at TanumStrand Spa & Resort to round out the weekend. Subscribers get access to a newsletter with current information and offers, including 20% off Asics trail shoes at Outnorth. The organizer’s text recommends accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand.

name: Skrylle Challenge
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-focused race organised by Björnstorps IF, starting and finishing at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organisers are introducing a new, more trail-focused loop course, with a choice of one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is promoted as a nature-close and challenging experience on the area’s best trails, and information will be updated throughout the spring. Early-bird places are available, and there is also a 600 m children’s race.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race in Bromölla organized by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers 10 km and 5 km distances, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is well marked, and officials are on hand to guide runners. Water stations with water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments including coffee and grilled sausages.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations with water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Race bibs must be collected from Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. Officials are positioned at intersections to provide guidance. Online registration is closed; late registration is available on site. The awards ceremony begins at 12:30. Medical staff are available in the start/finish area. Refreshments including coffee and grilled sausages are available after the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race is organised by the Mental Health Run association, and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy-to-run 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to take part, regardless of their background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual option.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a classic race, held for the 52nd time in 2026, offering a marathon and half marathon starting and finishing inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The course was officially measured in 2024 and is a flat, straight out-and-back route along the cycle path on the old railway embankment by the coast, with the turnaround at Lilla Amundön. Half-marathon runners complete one lap and marathon runners two, offering good opportunities for fast times. The race is organised by Solvikingarna, with the event centre at Friidrottens hus.

name: Umemaran
description: Umemaran is a traditional marathon and half marathon organized by Jalles TC Umeå together with IFK Umeå, starting and finishing at Tegs Centralskola. The marathon course (42 km) largely follows the Ume River via Ön and has a partly new, faster route. The course has been officially measured by an SFIF course measurer, and every kilometer is marked. Aid stations with Umara sports drink and water are available approximately every four kilometers. The event offers chip timing and shower facilities at the start area. Medals are awarded at the finish for both the 42 km and 21 km races, and the 42 km race is also held as the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården—a fun and challenging trail race where determination often matters more than perfect running form. The course features forest trails, muddy sections, wet areas and technical elements. Adults can choose between 5 or 10 km. For children, there is Kalvruset (approx. 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approx. 700 m). The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights is an evening race held during the Lights in Alingsås light festival, offering a magical, illuminated urban setting. The event has distances for all ages—from Maxi-Knatte and youth races to 5 km, 10 km, and a 3×1660 m relay. The start and finish are at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan), and the courses pass through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is family-friendly and is part of the Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwest Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day, Lilla Hässelbyloppet is also held, a race for children and young people with shorter distances. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. It is a festive event celebrating the joy of running and great performances in a welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Lilla Hässelbyloppet, with shorter distances for children and young people
The course is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Lilla Hässelbyloppet is provisionally scheduled to start at 11:00, and Hässelbyloppet at 12:00. Hässelby Idrottsplats is the event hub, close to the metro. Pacers are available for times between 37:30 and 60 minutes. Race bibs can be collected the day before the race. Drinks and snacks are provided after the finish. Timing is available from age 9, and results are published on the website.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail races focused on the experience of light and darkness meeting. You can choose 5 km, 10 km or 30 km, starting and finishing at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km distance, you navigate using a downloadable GPS route and map, and there are energy stations along the way. Sign up— all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteringsklubb.

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The races pass through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills along scenic trails and roads, with short courses for children and longer options for recreational runners. The youngest runners have a relatively flat course, and the event is designed as an enjoyable day with music, refreshments and award ceremonies. It is presented as a local, friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race consists of eight laps around Lake Växjö on what the organizer calls “Sweden’s fastest course.” The course is very flat (approximately 3 m of elevation gain) and mostly paved, with around 300 meters of fine gravel; the lap was officially measured in August 2024. A relay and children’s race are also offered, and the course is marked, with a lead cyclist and flag marshals.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race through the coastal woodlands and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organised by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 350 m with a medal and no timing. The gently undulating courses combine trails, sand dunes, varied terrain and running on sand along the coast—guaranteeing participants an exceptional running experience. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also features team competitions. The maximum number of participants is 1,000.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a fun race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are available, and the organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of running in the dark. Dog Trail is a special category where you can share the evening with your dog over 5 km or 10 km, on courses designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark—the courses are marked with reflective markers, and a headlamp is required. All proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense hill race in Hammarbybacken, taking place on 17 October 2026. The race is just over 3–3.5 km long, with a steep climb and more than 200 metres of elevation gain, and is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to challenge themselves. The finish is at the top of the hill, with a beautiful view over the city. The children’s races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 metres. The format features hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour, for a total of up to 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories is the participant who completes the most laps, with the fastest time on the final lap breaking a tie. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical yet runnable course through scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate start time in the afternoon.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-adjacent course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is October 18, and the races are designed as easy-to-run urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: VSM terräng
description: The 2026 Swedish Cross Country Championships are organized by Västerås Friidrott and will be held at Rocklunda IP in Västerås on October 24–25. The course is an easy-to-run cross-country course over a flat grassy area, with a 2–3-meter-wide gravel path that is crossed several times per lap. Hay bales are used as obstacles on parts of the course. The event welcomes runners of different ages and abilities and offers ample parking, as well as nearby accommodation and lunch service at Good Morning Hotels.
course_highlights: Flat grassy area with less than 0.5 meters of elevation difference
2–3-meter-wide gravel path crossed four times per lap
Hay bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels, 700 meters from the venue, on Saturday and Sunday for 130 SEK. Book lunch by emailing henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se no later than October 16. Plenty of free parking is available next to the competition area. The VSM categories start on Saturday, October 24; the first start is at 10:30 a.m. Free parking is available next to the competition area. Pre-booked lunch is available for 130 SEK.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with each lap to be completed in no more than 30 minutes. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. A headlamp is mandatory, as almost the entire race takes place in darkness. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, offering a challenge for anyone looking to test their limits in ultrarunning.
course_highlights: 13 laps of a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Change of running direction after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflectors and trail markers, and consists mostly of trails with around 700 metres of gravel
additional: Food and energy are provided during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), as well as sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and shelter from the elements. Toilets are in the woods. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and if you complete a lap faster, you can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. The race starts at the Linghemsskogen barbecue area. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes. A headlamp and mobile phone are mandatory items of equipment. Limited to 70 places; registration closes on 13 October. Participants who complete at least one lap receive a wooden medal.

name: Halloween Night Trail
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting and atmospheric trail race in the dark at the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby. The race offers three distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The courses are marked with reflectors and torches to guide runners through the darkness. After crossing the finish line, all participants are served a grilled hamburger and a drink, making for a pleasant end to the evening. The event has a Halloween theme, with decorations along the course, and encourages participants to dress up for an extra festive atmosphere. Ronneby Orienteering Club is the experienced race organiser.
course_highlights: Run on narrow trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Halloween-themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s lair and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors, and grilled hamburgers and drinks are served after the race
additional: Electronic timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances; no timing for the 2 km. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the venue from 17:00. A headlamp is recommended to help you follow the reflectors in the dark. The prize ceremony is tentatively scheduled for 20:45. Changing rooms and showers are available in limited numbers. Extra hamburgers can be purchased after the race. Parents may run with children in the 2 km without registering. Shoes with good grip are recommended because the surfaces may be wet and slippery. Electronic timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km, but not the 2 km. A hamburger and a small drink are included in the entry fee. The venue and finish are at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäsgården.

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, organised by Heleneholms IF in the autumn-coloured Bokskogen forest in Torup. The race starts and finishes at Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course runs through forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience nature in autumn. All practical information and the race invitation are available on the event’s information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn scenery and trails — traditionally held on the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, race categories, entry fees, course description, race information, start list and practical information are available in the tabs on the left-hand side of the event page. Race contact: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel. 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two distances (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; course map available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Hindås Trail
description: Hindås Trail is a running festival held on the beautiful fitness trails in Hindås on 25 October 2026. Participants can choose between a 1 km race for children, 5 km and 15 km. The event is suitable both for competitive runners and for those who want to enjoy a scenic run. After the finish, coffee and chocolate wafers are served, and hot dogs and a more substantial fika are available to buy at a good price. All proceeds go directly to the popular skiing activities in Hindås.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful fitness trails in Hindås
A children’s race on an easier 1 km course
Choose between 5 km and 15 km distances
additional: At the finish, participants are offered coffee and chocolate wafers. Hot dogs and a more substantial fika are also available to buy at a good price. All proceeds from the event go to the skiing activities in Hindås. All proceeds go to Hindås Ski Club’s skiing activities.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Slott Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around historic Löfstad Castle in Norrköping. The event offers two distances: Lilla Skymningsloppet, a 1,000-metre children’s race in the park, and Löfstads Mörkaste, a 7-kilometre night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain, where a headlamp is mandatory. The course winds through the beautiful castle park and forest and is marked with reflectors and tape for a safe and memorable running experience. Löfstad Slott Trail is a perfect start to the autumn holiday week and is organised by Orienteringsklubben Denseln, with a focus on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
